		public double? OperatingStepEndTime
		{
			get
			{
				string text = $"@main.SharedData.OperatingSteps.{SelectedOperatingStep}.EndTime";
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				double? num = null;
				if (val.value != null)
				{
					num = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)val.unitrow, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value) ?? 0.0, "sec");
				}
				return CxsConverter.ValueToDouble((object)num);
			}
		}

		public string ProfileListNo
		{
			get
			{
				double? operatingStepEndTime = OperatingStepEndTime;
				AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
				if (adsArrayData != null && adsArrayData.Count() > 0)
				{
					string text = "";
					string[] array = adsArrayData;
					foreach (string text2 in array)
					{
						text = $"@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList.{text2}.CurrentTime";
						adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
						if (adbElement.value != null)
						{
							double? d = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)24, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(adbElement.value) ?? 0.0, "sec");
							if (DoubleValuesAreEqual(operatingStepEndTime, d))
							{
								return text2;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return "";
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("ProfilesResultComposition_MultiMap.Value", (object)"ProfilesResultComposition_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("advbasis_var.Value", (object)ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Composition_Basis_Mole);
			}
			RefreshGrids();
			base.OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (_operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = true;
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			_view = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_Composition;
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void RefreshGrids()
		{
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (SelectedOperatingStep == null && _operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			else if (_operatingStepIditems != null && !_operatingStepIditems.Contains(SelectedOperatingStep))
			{
				if (_operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = null;
				}
			}
			Collection<string> operatingStepIditems = _operatingStepIditems;
			if (operatingStepIditems != null && operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = true;
			}
			else
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = false;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_CompsProfileListNo", (object)ProfileListNo);
			if (IsTimeProfileSelected.Value)
			{
				UpdateTimeProfileGridsData();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPauseButtonClick(BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs e)
		{
			Collection<string> operatingStepIds = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (operatingStepIds != null && operatingStepIds.Count > 0)
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = true;
				OperatingStepIditems = operatingStepIds;
				if (SelectedOperatingStep == null)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = operatingStepIds[0];
				}
			}
			if (IsTimeProfileSelected.Value)
			{
				UpdateTimeProfileGridsData();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_Composition view = _view;
			if (view != null)
			{
				DispatcherExtensions.BeginInvokeOnce(((DispatcherObject)(object)view).Dispatcher, (Action)RefreshGrids);
			}
		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}

		private int GetStartIndexOfTimeProfile(IEnumerable<string> aoList, out int aiCount)
		{
			aiCount = 0;
			if (aoList == null || aoList.Count() == 0)
			{
				return -99;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string text = "";
			foreach (string ao in aoList)
			{
				string[] array = ao.Trim().Split(',');
				if (array == null || array.Length != 2)
				{
					return -99;
				}
				text = array[0];
				if (!list.Contains(text))
				{
					list.Add(text);
				}
			}
			if (list == null && list.Count == 0)
			{
				return -99;
			}
			aiCount = list.Count();
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = list.OrderBy((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			string s = enumerable.First();
			int result = 0;
			int.TryParse(s, out result);
			return result;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetTimeProfileVarList(string asVarName)
		{
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList.@p_CompsProfileListNo.VarList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			IEnumerable<string> result = new Collection<string>();
			string varName = $"{asVarName}(";
			if (adsArrayData != null)
			{
				result = from sID in adsArrayData
					where sID.StartsWith(varName)
					select sID.Replace(varName, "").Replace(")", "");
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (subPropertyName == "Value" && (pd.Name == "IsTimeProfileSelected" || pd.Name == "advbasis_var" || pd.Name == "advview_var"))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_CompsProfileListNo", (object)ProfileListNo, true);
				UpdateTimeProfileGridsData();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void UpdateTimeProfileGridsData()
		{
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeLiquidMole_GridData");

			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeVaporMass_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeL1Mole_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeL1Mass_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeL2Mole_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeL2Mass_GridData");
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("ProfilesResultReactions_MultiMap.Value", (object)"ProfilesResultReactions_MultiMap_1");
			}
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			HasSteps = base.HasOperatingSteps;
			if (SelectedOperatingStep == null && _operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 1)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			else if (_operatingStepIditems != null && !_operatingStepIditems.Contains(SelectedOperatingStep))
			{
				if (_operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = null;
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_ReactionProfileListNo", (object)ProfileListNo, true);
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdStageReaction_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeStageReaction_GridData");
			base.OnUpdateData();
		}

		private bool NeedGetReactionsData()
		{
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.UseReactions", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || val.value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val.value.GetType() != typeof(bool))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (bool)val.value;
		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetTimeProfileVarList()
		{
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList.@p_ReactionProfileListNo.VarList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			IEnumerable<string> result = new Collection<string>();
			string sBlock = "RATE(";
			if (adsArrayData != null)
			{
				result = from sID in adsArrayData
					where sID.StartsWith(sBlock)
					select sID.Replace(sBlock, "").Replace(")", "");
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int GetStartIndexOfTimeProfile(IEnumerable<string> aoList, out int aiCount)
		{
			aiCount = 0;
			if (aoList == null || aoList.Count() == 0)
			{
				return -99;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string text = "";
			foreach (string ao in aoList)
			{
				string[] array = ao.Trim().Split(',');
				if (array == null || array.Length != 2)
				{
					return -99;
				}
				text = array[0];
				if (!list.Contains(text))
				{
					list.Add(text);
				}
			}
			if (list == null || list.Count() == 0)
			{
				return -99;
			}
			aiCount = list.Count();
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = list.OrderBy((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				return -99;
			}
			string s = enumerable.First();
			int result = 0;
			int.TryParse(s, out result);
			return result;
		}

		public string HoldupUnits
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_HoldupUnits))
				{
					string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("advbasis_var1") as string;
					string text2 = "";
					if (text == "Mole")
					{
						text2 = "@main.SharedData.DistReceivers.#0.ComponentMoleHoldup";
					}
					else if (text == "Mass")
					{
						text2 = "@main.SharedData.DistReceivers.#0.ComponentMassHoldup";
					}
					AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text2, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
					string result = null;
					if (val != null && val.unitrow > 0)
					{
						result = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.GetDefaultDisplayUnits((object)val.unitrow);
					}
					return result;
				}
				return _HoldupUnits;
			}
			set
			{
				_HoldupUnits = value;
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("HoldupUnits");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdHoldupMole_GridData");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdHoldupMass_GridData");
			}
		}

		}

					string text2 = "";
					if (text == "Mole")

					}
					else if (text == "Mass")
					{
						text2 = "@main.SharedData.DrumLiquidMassHoldup";
					}
					AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text2, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
					string result = null;
					if (val != null && val.unitrow > 0)
					{
						result = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.GetDefaultDisplayUnits((object)val.unitrow);
					}
					return result;
				}
				return _HoldupUnits;
			}
			set
			{
				_HoldupUnits = value;
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("HoldupUnits");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdHoldupMole_GridData");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdHoldupMass_GridData");

		private void SetType(string type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.PVTYPE.@id", "value", (object)null);
				return;
			}
			VarItem varItem = TypeValueList.Find((VarItem x) => x.Display == type);
			if (varItem != null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.PVTYPE.@id", "value", (object)varItem.Value);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			}
		}

				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.OPLOC.@id", "value", (object)varItem.Value);

			}
		}

		private void SetSelectedValues()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			string Value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.PVTYPE.@id", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Value))
			{
				VarItem varItem = TypeValueList.Find((VarItem x) => x.Value == Value);
				if (varItem != null && cboVarTypevw_var2.Contains(varItem.Display))
				{
					_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = varItem.Display;
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.PVTYPE.@id", "value", (object)null);
					_cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue = null;
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.PVUNIT.@id", "value", (object)null);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CONT_SP.@id", "value", (object)null);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CONT_SPTEMP.@id", "value", (object)null);
					flag = true;
				}
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarTypevw_SelectedValue");

		private string CreateNewVariableName(string name, string suffix)
		{
			if (name.Length < 8 - suffix.Length)
			{
				return name + suffix;
			}
			return name.Substring(0, 8 - suffix.Length) + suffix;
		}

		private void cmdDelete_Command_Execute(object args)
		{
			if (args != null)
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main"), (IEnumerable<string>)new Collection<string> { args as string }, false);
			}
			else
			{
				IEnumerable<string> selectedIds = GetSelectedIds();

			}
		}

		}

		private void rowDoubleClick_CommandExecute(object parameter)

		}

		{

					grdColumns_GridData_ItemTemplate grdColumns_GridData_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as grdColumns_GridData_ItemTemplate;
					yield return grdColumns_GridData_ItemTemplate.GetId();
				}
			}
		}

		public HeatXferGeometry HeatXferGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (_heatXferGeometry == null)
				{
					_heatXferGeometry = new HeatXferGeometry();

					_heatXferGeometry.ClearRequested += _heatXferGeometry_clearRequested;
					_heatXferGeometry.CutRequested += _heatXferGeometry_CutRequested;
					_heatXferGeometry.CopyRequested += _heatXferGeometry_CopyRequested;
					_heatXferGeometry.PasteRequested += _heatXferGeometry_PasteRequested;
					_heatXferGeometry.Dragging += _heatXferGeometry_Dragging;
				}
				return _heatXferGeometry;
			}
		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_PasteRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (double.TryParse(ClipboardWrapper.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text).ToString(), out var result))
			{
				(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = result;
			}
		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_CopyRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)

		}

		}

		private void _heatXferGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet((sender as InputVariable).DataPath, e.Attribute);

			{

		public string BlockPath
		{
			get
			{
				string result = null;
				string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
				if (text != null)
				{
					int num = text.LastIndexOf(".Subobjects.");
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						text = text.Substring(0, num);
					}
					int num2 = text.IndexOf(".Blocks.");
					result = text.Substring(num2 + 1);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public string BlockName
		{
			get
			{
				string result = null;
				string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
				if (text != null)
				{
					int num = text.IndexOf(".Subobjects.");
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						text = text.Substring(0, num);
					}
					string[] array = text.Split('.');
					if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
					{
						result = array[array.Length - 1];
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		{

			SetPausedFlag(1);
		}

		private void PauseButtonClick_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_isPauseChecked)
			{
				cmdPauseRun_CommandExecute(0);
				((CompositePresentationEvent<ResultGridRefreshEventEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<ResultGridRefreshEvent>()).Publish(new ResultGridRefreshEventEventArgs
				{
					BlockPath = BlockPath
				});
			}
			else
			{
				cmdResumeRun_CommandExecute(1);
			}
			((CompositePresentationEvent<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEvent>()).Publish(new BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs
			{
				IsPaused = _isPauseChecked
			});
		}

		private void cmdResumeRun_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			SmgeExtensions.SMResumeBatchSep((MMViewModel)(object)this, BlockFullName);
			SetPausedFlag(0);
		}

		protected override void OnUnityContainerChanged()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeFromAggregatedEvents();
				UnsubscribeFromCXSCaseMessages();
				SubscribeToAggregatedEvents();
				SubscribeToCXSCaseMessages();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnUnityContainerChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = text.LastIndexOf(".Subobjects.");
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, num);
			}
			_sBlockDataPath = text;
			if (_sCurBlockPath != null && _sCurBlockPath != BlockPath)
			{
				_sCurBlockPath = BlockPath;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				DisposeOfAllWatches();
			}
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				UpdatePauseButton();
			}
			if (iconConfigWatcher == null)
			{
				iconConfigWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				foreach (string cxsDataPath in cxsDataPaths)
				{
					string text2 = text + cxsDataPath;
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text2))
					{
						iconConfigWatcher.AddWatch(text2, "value");
					}
				}
				iconConfigWatcher.ValuesChanged += iconWatcher_ValuesChanged;
			}
			if (iconControllerConfigWatcher == null)
			{
				iconControllerConfigWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				_sControllerDataPath = _sBlockDataPath + ".Input";
				iconControllerConfigWatcher.AddWatch(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPLOC", "child_ids");
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPCHARGE", "child_ids", (string)null));
				if (array != null)
				{
					string[] array2 = array;
					foreach (string text3 in array2)
					{
						iconControllerConfigWatcher.AddWatch(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPCHARGE." + text3, "value");
					}
				}
				iconControllerConfigWatcher.ValuesChanged += iconWatcher_ControllerConfigChanged;
				BuildControllerSettingsWatchList();
			}
			if (feedStreamsWatcher == null)
			{
				feedStreamsWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				_feedStagesPath = text + ".Input.FEED_STAGE";
				feedStreamsWatcher.AddWatch(_feedStagesPath, "child_ids");
				string text4 = text + ".Input.CHARGE_STRM";
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text4))
				{
					feedStreamsWatcher.AddWatch(text4, "value");
				}
				feedStreamsWatcher.ValuesChanged += feedStreamsWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				AddPotChargeStreamInfo();
				InitializeFeedStreamsStagesWatcher();
			}
			LoadIcons();
		}

		private void feedStreamsWatcher_ValuesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AddPotChargeStreamInfo();
			InitializeFeedStreamsStagesWatcher();
			AddContinuousFeedStreams();
			CenterAndZoomToFit();
		}

		private void AddPotChargeStreamInfo()
		{
			object[] values = feedStreamsWatcher.Values;
			if (values == null || values.Length < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = feedStreamsWatcher.Values[1];
			if (obj != null)
			{
				StreamInfo streamInfo = animatableStreamsInfo.Find((StreamInfo info) => info.StreamName == "PotChargeStream");
				if (streamInfo != null)
				{
					animatableStreamsInfo.Remove(streamInfo);
				}
				string text = obj.ToString();
				StreamInfo item = new StreamInfo("CHARGE(" + text + ").F", "ChargeStreams." + text + ".MassFlow", "PotChargeStream", ValidPhases.VaporLiquid | ValidPhases.VaporLiquidLiquid, isReceiverStream: false);
				animatableStreamsInfo.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void DisposeOfFeedStreamsStagesWatcher()
		{
			if (feedStreamsStagesWatcher != null)
			{
				feedStreamsStagesWatcher.ValuesChanged -= feedStreamsStagesWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				feedStreamsStagesWatcher.ValuesChanged -= feedStreamsStagesWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				feedStreamsStagesWatcher.Unload();
				feedStreamsStagesWatcher = null;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeFeedStreamsStagesWatcher()
		{
			DisposeOfFeedStreamsStagesWatcher();
			string[] feedStreamsList = GetFeedStreamsList();
			if (feedStreamsList != null && feedStreamsList.Length != 0)
			{
				feedStreamsStagesWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				feedStreamsStagesWatcher.ValuesChanged += feedStreamsStagesWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				string[] array = feedStreamsList;
				foreach (string text in array)
				{
					feedStreamsStagesWatcher.AddWatch(_feedStagesPath + "." + text, "value");
				}
			}
		}

		private void feedStreamsStagesWatcher_ValuesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			LoadIcons();
		}

		private string[] GetFeedStreamsList()
		{
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_feedStagesPath, "child_ids", (string)null);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(obj);
		}

		private void UpdateStreamAnimations_ADS()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = 0.0001;
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < animatableStreamsInfo.Count; i++)
				{
					StreamInfo streamInfo = animatableStreamsInfo[i];
					if (streamInfo.ValidPhases.HasFlag(validPhases))
					{
						double? streamFlow = DataProvider.GetStreamFlow(streamInfo.ADSVariable);
						if (streamFlow.HasValue)
						{
							streamInfo.IsFlowing = streamFlow.Value > num;
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (StreamInfo item in animatableStreamsInfo)
				{
					Connection val = SmartIconContainer.FindConnection(item.StreamName);
					if (item.ValidPhases.HasFlag(validPhases) && val != null)
					{
						if (item.IsFlowing)
						{
							AnimateStream(val);
						}
						else
						{
							StopAnimatingStream(val);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating stream animations." + Environment.NewLine + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)3);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateStreamAnimations()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				double num = 0.0001;
				for (int i = 0; i < animatableStreamsInfo.Count; i++)
				{
					StreamInfo streamInfo = animatableStreamsInfo[i];
					if (streamInfo.ValidPhases.HasFlag(validPhases))
					{
						_ = streamInfo.IsFlowing;
						if (double.TryParse(GetEOValue(streamInfo.EOVariable), out var result))
						{
							streamInfo.IsFlowing = result > num;
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (StreamInfo item in animatableStreamsInfo)
				{
					Connection val = SmartIconContainer.FindConnection(item.StreamName);
					if (item.ValidPhases.HasFlag(validPhases) && val != null)
					{
						if (item.IsFlowing)
						{
							AnimateStream(val);
						}
						else
						{
							StopAnimatingStream(val);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating stream animations." + Environment.NewLine + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)3);
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimatingStream(Connection connection)
		{
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DoubleCollection strokeDashArray = null;
			foreach (Polyline item in ((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)connection).Children.OfType<Polyline>())
			{
				item.StrokeDashArray = strokeDashArray;
				if (item.Tag is Storyboard storyboard)
				{
					storyboard.Stop();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AnimateStream(Connection connection)
		{
			if (connection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (Polyline item in ((System.Windows.Controls.Panel)(object)connection).Children.OfType<Polyline>())
			{
				DoubleCollection strokeDashArray = item.StrokeDashArray;
				if (strokeDashArray != null && strokeDashArray.Count > 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				item.StrokeDashArray = dashPattern;
				Storyboard streamFlowAnimation = StreamFlowAnimation;
				Storyboard.SetTarget(streamFlowAnimation, item);
				item.Tag = streamFlowAnimation;
				streamFlowAnimation.Begin();
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimationsAndSaveFlowsheet()
		{
			System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					IEnumerable<Connection> source = SmartIconContainer.Connections.Where((Connection connection) => !IsControllerStream(connection));
					for (int num = 0; num < source.Count(); num++)
					{
						StopAnimatingStream(source.ElementAt(num));
					}
					UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText(reset: true);
					CenterAndZoomToFit();
					SetPausedFlag(0);
					UpdatePauseButton(IsQuit: true);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void BuildControllerSettingsWatchList()
		{
			if (iconControllerSettingsWatcher != null)
			{
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher.ValuesChanged -= iconWatcher_ControllerSettingsChanged;
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher.Unload();
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher = null;
			}
			string[] controllerIdList = GetControllerIdList();
			if (controllerIdList != null && controllerIdList.Length != 0)
			{
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.CreateWatch();
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher.ValuesChanged += iconWatcher_ControllerSettingsChanged;
				int num = controllerIdList.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					iconControllerSettingsWatcher.AddWatch(_sControllerDataPath + ".PVTYPE." + controllerIdList[i], "value");
					iconControllerSettingsWatcher.AddWatch(_sControllerDataPath + ".PVPHASE." + controllerIdList[i], "value");
					iconControllerSettingsWatcher.AddWatch(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPLOC." + controllerIdList[i], "value");
				}
			}
		}

		private void iconWatcher_ValuesChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ResetHeatOverlayInfo();
			LoadIcons();
			UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText(reset: true);
		}

		private void iconWatcher_ControllerConfigChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			BuildControllerSettingsWatchList();
			LoadIcons();
		}

		private void iconWatcher_ControllerSettingsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			LoadIcons();
		}

		private void LoadIcons()
		{
			try
			{
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View != null && iconConfigWatcher != null && iconConfigWatcher.Values != null && iconConfigWatcher.Values.Length != 0 && !iconConfigWatcher.Values.All((object val) => val == null))
				{
					GetConfigurationInfo();
					ClearTheContainer();
					LoadTemplateIcon();
					if (potOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal || jacketSetting != JacketSetting.FullJacket)
					{
						AddHeatOverlay("Pot");
					}
					AddContinuousFeedStreams();
					AddHeatTransferIcons();
					AddRefluxDrum();
					AddRefluxSplitter();
					if (hasColumn)
					{
						AddHeatOverlay("Column");
					}
					if (hasCoils)
					{
						AddHeatOverlay("Coils");
					}
					if (hasHX)
					{
						AddHeatOverlay("HX");
					}
					SetUpReceivers();
					AddControllers();
					CenterAndZoomToFit();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void AddContinuousFeedStreams()
		{
			try
			{
				if (feedStreamsStagesWatcher == null)
				{
					InitializeFeedStreamsStagesWatcher();
				}
				IEnumerable<Connection> source = SmartIconContainer.Connections.Where((Connection c) => IsFeedStream(c));
				while (source.Count() > 0)
				{
					SmartIconContainer.DeleteConnection(source.Last());
				}
				if (feedStreamsWatcher == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				object obj = feedStreamsWatcher.Values[1];
				if (obj != null)
				{
					string text = obj.ToString();
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
					{
						ConnectFeedStream(text, numStages);
					}
				}
				if (feedStreamsStagesWatcher == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string[] feedStreamsList = GetFeedStreamsList();
				for (int num = 0; num < feedStreamsList.Length; num++)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(feedStreamsList[num]))
					{
						int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_feedStagesPath + "." + feedStreamsList[num], "value", (string)null));
						ConnectFeedStream(feedStreamsList[num], num2.HasValue ? num2.Value : 2);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string text2 = "Failed to add feed streams." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text2 + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void ConnectFeedStream(string streamName, int feedStage)
		{
			try
			{
				if (feedStage <= NumStages)
				{
					string text = "Unable to find target port for feed stream.";
					bool showArrows = true;
					Port feedStreamPortNear = GetFeedStreamPortNear(feedStage, ref showArrows);
					if (feedStreamPortNear == null)
					{
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
						return;
					}
					int num = 100;
					string text2 = streamName.Replace("-", "_1");
					text2 = text2.Replace("+", "_2");
					text2 = "FeedStream_" + text2;
					Connection obj = SmartIconContainer.Connect((Port)null, feedStreamPortNear, false, (double)num, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
					obj.SetName(text2);
					obj.AddLabel(streamName, 10);
					StreamInfo item = new StreamInfo("CHARGE(" + streamName + ").F", "ChargeStreams." + streamName + ".MassFlow", text2, ValidPhases.VaporLiquid | ValidPhases.VaporLiquidLiquid, isReceiverStream: false);
					animatableStreamsInfo.Add(item);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string text3 = "Failed to connect a feed stream: '" + streamName + "'." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text3 + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private Port GetFeedStreamPortNear(int feedStage, ref bool showArrows)
		{
			string text = "Unable to find port for charge stream; target icon was missing or had no ports.";
			Port val = null;
			if (feedStage == numStages || !hasColumn)
			{
				IconCtrl val2 = FindIcon("Pot");
				if (val2 == null || val2.Ports == null)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					return null;
				}
				return val2.FindPort("ChargeStream");
			}
			IconCtrl val3 = FindIcon("Column");
			if (val3 == null || val3.Ports == null)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				return null;
			}
			int count = val3.Ports.FindAll((Port port) => port.Name != null && port.Name.StartsWith("Left")).Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				return null;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling(1.0 * (double)count * (double)feedStage / (double)NumStages);
			if (num < 1 || num > count)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Invalid target port number.", (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = num;
			return val3.FindPort("Left" + num2);
		}

		private int CalculateNewFeedPortNumber(int desiredPortNumber, int numFeedPorts, int probeAttempt)
		{
			int num = (int)((double)(int)Math.Ceiling((double)probeAttempt / 2.0) * Math.Pow(-1.0, probeAttempt));
			int num2 = desiredPortNumber + num;
			if (num2 > numFeedPorts || num2 < 1)
			{
				num2 = desiredPortNumber - num;
				if (num2 > numFeedPorts || num2 < 1)
				{
					return -9999;
				}
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private bool TryGetIntValue(object o, ref int result)
		{
			if (o == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return int.TryParse(o.ToString(), out result);
		}

		private bool TryGetIntValue(object o, ref int? result)
		{
			if (o == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (int.TryParse(o.ToString(), out var result2))
			{
				result = result2;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void GetConfigurationInfo()
		{
			if (iconConfigWatcher == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object[] values = iconConfigWatcher.Values;
			if (values == null || values.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = iconConfigWatcher.Values[29];
			if (obj.ToString() == "POT")
			{
				hasColumn = false;
				hasSecondCondenser = false;
				hasRefluxDrum = false;
				hasPotOnly = true;
			}
			else
			{
				hasPotOnly = false;
			}
			try
			{
				bool ignoreCase = true;
				potOrientation = Orientation.Vertical;
				object obj2 = values[0];
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					potOrientation = (Orientation)Enum.Parse(typeof(Orientation), obj2.ToString(), ignoreCase);
				}
				numStages = 2;
				TryGetIntValue(values[1], ref numStages);
				PotColumn potColumn = ((numStages <= 2) ? PotColumn.NoColumn : PotColumn.Column);
				if (potColumn == PotColumn.Column || numStages == 2)
				{
					if (obj.ToString() == "POT" || numStages == 2)
					{
						hasColumn = false;
					}
					else if (numStages > 2)
					{
						hasColumn = potColumn != PotColumn.NoColumn;
					}
				}
				condenserSetting = CondenserSetting.Partial;
				hasSecondCondenser = false;
				object obj3 = values[2];
				if (obj3 != null)
				{
					condenserSetting = (CondenserSetting)Enum.Parse(typeof(CondenserSetting), obj3.ToString(), ignoreCase);
					hasSecondCondenser = condenserSetting == CondenserSetting.Partial2;
				}
				hasRefluxDrum = false;
				if (values[3] != null && (values[3].ToString() == "YES" || 1 == 0))
				{
					if (obj.ToString() == "POT")
					{
						hasRefluxDrum = false;
					}
					else
					{
						hasRefluxDrum = values[3].ToString() == "YES";
					}
				}
				jacketSetting = JacketSetting.NoJacket;
				coilsSetting = CoilsSetting.NoCoils;
				hxSetting = HXSetting.NoHX;
				hasJacket = false;
				hasCoils = false;
				hasHX = false;
				object obj4 = values[28];
				if (obj4 != null && obj4.ToString().ToUpper() == "DETAILED")
				{
					int result = -1;
					int result2 = -1;
					TryGetIntValue(values[5], ref result);
					TryGetIntValue(values[6], ref result2);
					jacketHeating = result == 1;
					jacketCooling = result2 == 1;
					hasJacket = jacketHeating || jacketCooling;
					if (hasPotOnly && potOrientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
					{
						hasJacket = false;
					}
					if (hasJacket)
					{
						bool flag = (int)values[7] == 1;
						jacketSetting = ((!flag) ? JacketSetting.PartialJacket : JacketSetting.FullJacket);
					}
					int result3 = -1;
					int result4 = -1;
					TryGetIntValue(values[8], ref result3);
					TryGetIntValue(values[9], ref result4);
					coilHeating = result3 == 1;
					coilCooling = result4 == 1;
					hasCoils = coilHeating || coilCooling;
					if (hasCoils)
					{
						coilsSetting = CoilsSetting.Coils;
					}
					int result5 = -1;
					int result6 = -1;
					TryGetIntValue(values[10], ref result5);
					TryGetIntValue(values[11], ref result6);
					hxHeating = result5 == 1;
					hxCooling = result6 == 1;
					hasHX = hxHeating || hxCooling;
					if (hasHX)
					{
						hxSetting = HXSetting.HX;
					}
				}
				validPhases = ValidPhases.VaporLiquidLiquid;
				object obj5 = values[12];
				string text = null;
				if (obj5 != null)
				{
					text = obj5.ToString();
				}
				if ((!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) && string.Equals(text, "VL", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)) || (int.TryParse(text, out var result7) && result7 == 2))
				{
					object obj6 = values[13];
					string a = null;
					if (obj6 != null)
					{
						a = obj6.ToString();
					}
					if (string.Equals(a, "NO", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
					{
						validPhases = ValidPhases.VaporLiquid;
					}
				}
				if (hasRefluxDrum)
				{
					drumOrientation = Orientation.Vertical;
					object obj7 = values[23];
					if (obj7 != null)
					{
						drumOrientation = (Orientation)Enum.Parse(typeof(Orientation), obj7.ToString(), ignoreCase);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void SaveHeatOverlayValues()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View != null)
			{
				hInfo = new HeatOverlayInfo
				{
					BottomTemperature = GetIconAnimationValue("PotHeatOverlay", "BottomColor"),
					TopTemperature = (hasColumn ? GetIconAnimationValue("ColumnHeatOverlay", "TopColor") : null),
					JacketMode = ((hasJacket && potOrientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? GetIconAnimationValue(jacketSetting.ToString() + "HeatOverlay", "OverlayColor") : null),
					CoilsMode = (hasCoils ? GetIconAnimationValue("CoilsHeatOverlay", "OverlayColor") : null),
					HXMode = (hasHX ? GetIconAnimationValue("HXHeatOverlay", "OverlayColor") : null)
				};
			}
		}

		private void AddRefluxDrum()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!hasRefluxDrum)
				{

				}

					xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)

					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for reflux drum icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					return;
				}
				string sinkName = (hasColumn ? "Column" : "Pot");
				Connection val = SmartIconContainer.Connections.Find((Connection c) => c.SourcePort != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)c.SourcePort.Ctrl).Name == "Condenser1" && c.SinkPort != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)c.SinkPort.Ctrl).Name == sinkName);
				SmartIconContainer.DeleteConnection(val);
				string text2 = "Condenser1;S;Bottom;25;";
				IconCtrl val2 = SmartIconContainer.AddIcon(xmlDocument, text2);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).Name = "RefluxDrum";
				IconCtrl val3 = FindIcon("Condenser1");
				FindIcon(sinkName);
				int num = ((drumOrientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? 25 : 35);
				SmartIconContainer.Connect(val3, "Bottom", val2, "Top", true, (double)num, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				string text3 = "Failed to add reflux drum." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text3 + ex2.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void AddHeatOverlay(string underlyingIconName)
		{
			try
			{
				string value = ".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Converted.";
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(assemblyName);
				stringBuilder.Append(value);
				if (underlyingIconName == "Pot" || underlyingIconName == "Coils")
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(potOrientation);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(underlyingIconName);
				stringBuilder.Append("Overlay.xml");
				XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
				try
				{
					using StreamReader txtReader = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(stringBuilder.ToString()));
					xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for '" + underlyingIconName + "' overlay icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					return;
				}
				IconCtrl val = FindIcon(underlyingIconName);
				if (val == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				double num = default(double);
				double num2 = default(double);
				double num3 = default(double);
				val.GetPosition(ref num, ref num2, ref num3);
				IconCtrl val2 = SmartIconContainer.LoadIcon(xmlDocument, num, num2, num3, (XmlNamespaceManager)null);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).Name = underlyingIconName + "HeatOverlay";
				if (hInfo.HasValue)
				{
					HeatOverlayInfo value2 = hInfo.Value;
					switch (underlyingIconName)
					{
					case "Column":
						val2.SetAnimationValue("TopColor", value2.TopTemperature);
						goto case "Pot";
					case "Pot":
						val2.SetAnimationValue("BottomColor", value2.BottomTemperature);
						break;
					case "FullJacket":
					case "PartialJacket":
						val2.SetAnimationValue("OverlayColor", value2.JacketMode);
						break;
					case "Coils":
						val2.SetAnimationValue("OverlayColor", value2.CoilsMode);
						break;
					case "HX":
						val2.SetAnimationValue("OverlayColor", value2.HXMode);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				string text = "Failed to add heat overlay for: '" + underlyingIconName + "'." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text + ex2.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}
