		private void AddRefluxSplitter()
		{
			try
			{
				if (hasPotOnly)
				{
					return;
				}
				string text = ".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Converted.";
				string name = string.Concat(assemblyName + text, "RefluxSplitter.xml");
				XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
				try
				{
					using StreamReader txtReader = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name));
					xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for splitter icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					return;
				}
				string iconName = (hasRefluxDrum ? "RefluxDrum" : "Condenser1");
				string text2 = (hasColumn ? "Column" : "Pot");
				IconCtrl val = FindIcon(text2);
				Connection val2 = SmartIconContainer.Connections.Find((Connection c) => c.SinkPort != null && c.SinkPort.Ctrl != null && (((FrameworkElement)(object)c.SinkPort.Ctrl).Name == "Pot" || ((FrameworkElement)(object)c.SinkPort.Ctrl).Name == "Column") && c.SinkPort.Name == "TopRight");
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					SmartIconContainer.DeleteConnection(val2);
				}
				string text3 = text2 + ";E;TopRight;" + (hasColumn ? 77.8 : 87.7) + ";";
				IconCtrl val3 = SmartIconContainer.AddIcon(xmlDocument, text3);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)val3).Name = "RefluxSplitter";
				IconCtrl val4 = FindIcon(iconName);
				val4.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Bottom");
				SmartIconContainer.Connect(val4, "Bottom", val3, "Top", false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
				SmartIconContainer.Connect(val3, "Left", val, "TopRight", false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				string text4 = "Failed to add reflux splitter" + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text4 + ex2.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private string[] GetControllerIdList()
		{
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPLOC", "child_ids", (string)null);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(obj);
		}

		private void RemoveControllers()
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IEnumerable<Connection> source = SmartIconContainer.Connections.Where((Connection connection) => IsControllerStream(connection));
			while (source.Count() > 0)
			{
				SmartIconContainer.DeleteConnection(source.Last());
			}
			IEnumerable<IconCtrl> source2 = SmartIconContainer.Icons.Where((IconCtrl icon) => IsController(icon));
			while (source2.Count() > 0)
			{
				IconCtrl val = source2.Last();
				val.IconEditorEvent -= new IconEditorEventHandler(Icon_IconEditorEvent);
				((UIElement)(object)val).MouseEnter -= Icon_MouseEnterEvent;
				((UIElement)(object)val).MouseLeave -= Icon_MouseLeaveEvent;
				SmartIconContainer.DeleteIcon(val);
			}
		}

		private void AddControllers()
		{
			try
			{
				string text = ".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Converted.";
				string name = assemblyName + text + "Controller.xml";
				XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
				try
				{
					using StreamReader txtReader = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name));
					xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for controller icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					return;
				}
				string[] controllerIdList = GetControllerIdList();
				if (controllerIdList == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = controllerIdList.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPLOC." + controllerIdList[i], "value", (string)null);
					if (obj == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(obj);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						continue;
					}
					object obj2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_sControllerDataPath + ".PVTYPE." + controllerIdList[i], "value", (string)null);
					if (obj2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(obj2);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					object obj3 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_sControllerDataPath + ".PVPHASE." + controllerIdList[i], "value", (string)null);
					if (obj3 != null)
					{
						string text4 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(obj3);
						flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4) && text4 == "VAPOR";
					}
					string text5 = string.Empty;
					string text6 = "ControlPV";
					switch (text3)
					{
					case "C-V-MOLEFLOW":
					case "C-V-MASSFLOW":
						text5 = "Condenser1";
						text6 = "ControlPVVapor";
						break;
					case "C-L-MOLEFLOW":
					case "C-L-MASSFLOW":
						text5 = "Condenser1";
						text6 = "ControlPVLiquid";
						break;
					case "D-MOLEFRAC":
					case "D-MASSFRAC":
						text5 = "Condenser1";
						text6 = (flag ? "ControlPVVapor" : "ControlPVLiquid");
						break;
					case "C-MOLEFRAC":
					case "C-MASSFRAC":
					case "C2-MASSFRAC":
					case "C2-MOLEFRAC":
						text5 = ((text3.Substring(0, 2) == "C2") ? "Condenser2" : "Condenser1");
						text6 = (flag ? "ControlPVVapor" : "ControlPVLiquid");
						break;
					case "COND-TEMP":
						text5 = "Condenser1";
						text6 = "ControlPVTemp";
						break;
					case "COND2-TEMP":
						text5 = "Condenser2";
						text6 = "ControlPVTemp";
						break;
					case "P-MASSHOLDUP":
					case "P-MOLEHOLDUP":
					case "P-MOLEFRAC":
					case "P-MASSFRAC":
					case "P-LIQLEVEL":
					case "P-LIQVOLUME":
					case "POT-TEMP":
					case "POT-DUTY":
					case "POT-PRES":
						text5 = "Pot";
						break;
					case "RR":
						text5 = "RefluxSplitter";
						break;
					case "STG-LIQLEVEL":
					case "STAGE-MOLFRA":
					case "STAGE-MASFRA":
					case "STAGE-TEMP":
					case "COL-PDROP":
						text5 = "Column";
						break;
					case "COIL-CDUTY":
					case "COIL-HDELT":
					case "COIL-HDUTY":
					case "COIL-DELT":
						text5 = "Coils";
						break;
					case "JACK-CDELT":
					case "JACK-HDELT":
					case "JACK-CDUTY":
					case "JACK-HDUTY":
						if (jacketSetting == JacketSetting.FullJacket)
						{
							text5 = "FullJacket";
						}
						else if (jacketSetting == JacketSetting.PartialJacket)
						{
							text5 = "PartialJacket";
						}
						break;
					case "EX-CDUTY":
					case "EX-HDUTY":
					case "EX-CDELT":
					case "EX-HDELT":
						text5 = "HX";
						break;
					default:
						text5 = string.Empty;
						text6 = string.Empty;
						break;
					}
					string text7 = string.Empty;
					string text8 = "ControlMV";
					string text9 = string.Empty;
					switch (text2)
					{
					case "SPLITTER":
						text7 = "RefluxSplitter";
						break;
					case "CONDENSER":
						text7 = "Condenser1";
						break;
					case "CHARGE-STRM":
					{
						string text10 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(_sControllerDataPath + ".OPCHARGE." + controllerIdList[i], "value", (string)null));
						if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text10))
						{
							continue;
						}
						Connection val = SmartIconContainer.FindConnection("FeedStream_" + text10);
						if (val == null || val.SinkPort == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(val.SinkPort.Name) || val.SinkPort.Ctrl == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((FrameworkElement)(object)val.SinkPort.Ctrl).Name))
						{
							continue;
						}
						text7 = ((FrameworkElement)(object)val.SinkPort.Ctrl).Name;
						text8 = val.SinkPort.Name;
						text9 = text10;
						break;
					}
					case "JACKET":
						if (jacketSetting == JacketSetting.FullJacket)
						{
							text7 = "FullJacket";
						}
						else if (jacketSetting == JacketSetting.PartialJacket)
						{
							text7 = "PartialJacket";
						}
						break;
					case "CONDENSER2":
						text7 = "Condenser2";
						break;
					case "SIDE-DRAW":
						text7 = (hasPotOnly ? "Pot" : "Column");
						break;
					case "POT":
						text7 = "Pot";
						break;
					case "COILS":
						text7 = "Coils";
						break;
					case "EXCHANGER":
						text7 = "HX";
						break;
					default:
						text7 = string.Empty;
						text8 = string.Empty;
						text9 = string.Empty;
						break;
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text6) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text7) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text8))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if ((!hasSecondCondenser && (text5 == "Condenser2" || text7 == "Condenser2")) || (!hasColumn && (text5 == "Column" || text7 == "Column")) || (!hasCoils && (text5 == "Coils" || text7 == "Coils")) || (!hasJacket && (text5 == "FullJacket" || text7 == "FullJacket" || text5 == "PartialJacket" || text7 == "PartialJacket")) || (!hasHX && (text5 == "HX" || text7 == "HX")))
					{
						string text11 = "BatchSep configuration was changed after the controller was added such that one of its icons was intentionally removed. The controller icon will thus be removed as well.";
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text11, (Category)2, (Priority)0);
						break;
					}
					IconCtrl val2 = FindIcon(text5);
					if (val2 == null)
					{
						string text12 = "Could not find controller source icon: " + text5;
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text12, (Category)3, (Priority)2);
						continue;
					}
					IconCtrl val3 = FindIcon(text7);
					if (val3 == null)
					{
						string text13 = "Could not find controller destination icon: " + text7;
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text13, (Category)3, (Priority)2);
						continue;
					}
					string text14 = (hasSecondCondenser ? "230" : "150");
					string text15 = (hasColumn ? "Column;E;TopRight;" : "Pot;E;TopRight;") + text14;
					IconCtrl val4 = SmartIconContainer.AddIcon(xmlDocument, text15);
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val4).Name = "Controller" + i;
					Connection obj4 = SmartIconContainer.Connect(val2, text6, val4, "Top", false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "4", "", "");
					if (obj4 == null)
					{
						string text16 = "Failed to create controller connection to source icon: " + text5;
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text16, (Category)3, (Priority)2);
					}
					obj4.SetName(((FrameworkElement)(object)val4).Name + "PV");
					Connection val5 = SmartIconContainer.Connect(val4, "Bottom", val3, text8, false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "4", string.Empty, text9);
					if (obj4 == null)
					{
						string text17 = "Failed to create controller connection to destination icon: " + text7;
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text17, (Category)3, (Priority)2);
					}
					val5.SetName(((FrameworkElement)(object)val4).Name + "MV");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex2)
			{
				string text18 = "Failed to add controllers." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text18 + ex2.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void AddHeatTransferIcons()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!hasJacket && !hasCoils && !hasHX)
				{
					return;
				}
				IconCtrl val = FindIcon("Pot");
				if (val == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				string text = ".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Converted.";
				string text2 = assemblyName + text;
				if (hasJacket && potOrientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					string name = text2 + jacketSetting.ToString() + ".xml";
					XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
					try
					{
						using StreamReader txtReader = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name));
						xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for jacket icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					}
					if (xmlDocument.DocumentElement != null)
					{
						IconCtrl val2 = SmartIconContainer.LoadIcon(xmlDocument, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, (XmlNamespaceManager)null);
						((FrameworkElement)(object)val2).Name = jacketSetting.ToString();
						SmartIconContainer.Connect(val, "Bottom", val2, "Center", true, 0.0, false, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
						AddHeatOverlay(jacketSetting.ToString());
						if (jacketSetting == JacketSetting.FullJacket)
						{
							double num = default(double);
							double num2 = default(double);
							double num3 = default(double);
							val.GetPosition(ref num, ref num2, ref num3);
							SmartIconContainer.DeleteIcon(val);
							string name2 = text2 + potOrientation.ToString() + "Pot.xml";
							XmlDocument xmlDocument2 = new XmlDocument();
							try
							{
								using StreamReader txtReader2 = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name2));
								xmlDocument2.Load(txtReader2);
							}
							catch (Exception ex2)
							{
								SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for pot icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex2, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
							}
							if (xmlDocument2.DocumentElement != null)
							{
								val = SmartIconContainer.LoadIcon(xmlDocument2, num, num2, num3, (XmlNamespaceManager)null);
								((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name = "Pot";
								AddHeatOverlay("Pot");
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (hasCoils)
				{
					string name3 = text2 + potOrientation.ToString() + "Coils.xml";
					XmlDocument xmlDocument3 = new XmlDocument();
					try
					{
						using StreamReader txtReader3 = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name3));
						xmlDocument3.Load(txtReader3);
					}
					catch (Exception ex3)
					{
						SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for coils icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex3, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
					}
					if (xmlDocument3.DocumentElement != null)
					{
						IconCtrl val3 = SmartIconContainer.LoadIcon(xmlDocument3, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, (XmlNamespaceManager)null);
						((FrameworkElement)(object)val3).Name = coilsSetting.ToString();
						SmartIconContainer.Connect(val, "Center", val3, "Center", true, 0.0, false, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
					}
				}
				if (!hasHX)
				{
					return;
				}
				string name4 = text2 + "HX.xml";
				XmlDocument xmlDocument4 = new XmlDocument();
				try
				{
					using StreamReader txtReader4 = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name4));
					xmlDocument4.Load(txtReader4);
				}
				catch (Exception ex4)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for HX icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex4, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				}
				if (xmlDocument4.DocumentElement != null)
				{
					string text3 = "Pot;SE;Right;70";
					IconCtrl val4 = SmartIconContainer.AddIcon(xmlDocument4, text3);
					((FrameworkElement)(object)val4).Name = hxSetting.ToString();
					SmartIconContainer.Connect(val, "Bottom", val4, "Bottom", false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
					SmartIconContainer.Connect(val4, "Top", val, "Right", false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex5)
			{
				string text4 = "Failed to add heat transfer icons." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text4 + ex5.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		internal void CenterAndZoomToFit()
		{
			try
			{
				SaveFlowsheet();
				ClearTheContainer();
				LoadSavedFlowsheet();
				PostLoadFlowsheet();
				if (_bAnimationsEnabled && _isPauseChecked && _isPauseButtonEnabled)
				{
					UpdateVisualsDuringRun();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string text = "Failed to center and zoom to fit." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void DeleteLiquidLevelIcons()
		{
			IEnumerable<IconCtrl> source = SmartIconContainer.Icons.Where((IconCtrl icon) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name.EndsWith("LiquidLevel", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || ((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name.EndsWith("LiquidLevel2", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
			while (source.Count() > 0)
			{
				SmartIconContainer.DeleteIcon(source.Last());
			}
		}

		private void SaveFlowsheet()
		{
			DeleteLiquidLevelIcons();
			savedFlowsheet = SmartIconContainer.Save();
			AddLiquidLevels();
			UpdateLiquidLevels();
		}

		private void LoadSavedFlowsheet()
		{
			SmartIconContainer.Open(savedFlowsheet, 2, 0.01);
		}

		private void PostLoadFlowsheet()
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (SmartIconContainer.FindIcon("PotLiquidLevel") == null || (hasRefluxDrum && SmartIconContainer.FindIcon("RefluxDrumLiquidLevel") == null))
			{
				AddLiquidLevels();
			}
			UpdateIconOverlays_ADS();
			foreach (IconCtrl icon in SmartIconContainer.Icons)
			{
				icon.IconEditorEvent -= new IconEditorEventHandler(Icon_IconEditorEvent);
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseEnter -= Icon_MouseEnterEvent;
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseLeave -= Icon_MouseLeaveEvent;
				icon.IconEditorEvent += new IconEditorEventHandler(Icon_IconEditorEvent);
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseEnter += Icon_MouseEnterEvent;
				((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseLeave += Icon_MouseLeaveEvent;
				TextBlock tip = new TextBlock();
				string overlaysTargetIconName = GetOverlaysTargetIconName(((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name);
				tip.Text = GetToolTipForIcon(overlaysTargetIconName);
				((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).ToolTip = tip;
				if (IsController(((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name))
				{
					icon.Highlight("#00FFFFFF");
				}
				icon.Ports.ForEach(delegate(Port port)
				{
					((FrameworkElement)(object)port).ToolTip = tip;
				});
			}
			((UIElement)(object)SmartIconContainer).MouseRightButtonUp += SmartIconContainer_MouseRightButtonUp;
		}

		private void SmartIconContainer_MouseRightButtonUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		private void ClearTheContainer()
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			try
			{
				foreach (IconCtrl icon in SmartIconContainer.Icons)
				{
					icon.IconEditorEvent -= new IconEditorEventHandler(Icon_IconEditorEvent);
					((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseEnter -= Icon_MouseEnterEvent;
					((UIElement)(object)icon).MouseLeave -= Icon_MouseLeaveEvent;
				}
				SmartIconContainer.Clear();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				string text = "Failed to clear the container." + Environment.NewLine;
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private string GetToolTipForIcon(string sIconName)
		{
			string empty = string.Empty;
			switch (sIconName)
			{
			case "Coils":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Coils_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "Column":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Column_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "Condenser1":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Condenser_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "Condenser2":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Condenser2_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "HX":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_HX_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "FullJacket":
			case "PartialJacket":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Jacket_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "Pot":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Pot_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "RefluxDrum":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_RefluxDrum_Tooltip;
				break;
			case "RefluxSplitter":
				empty = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_RefluxSplitter_Tooltip;
				break;
			default:
				empty = sIconName;
				if (IsReceiver(sIconName))
				{
					string s = sIconName.Substring(8);
					int result = -1;
					if (int.TryParse(s, out result))
					{
						result++;
						empty = string.Format(ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Receiver_Tooltip, result);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!IsController(sIconName))
					{
						break;
					}
					string s2 = sIconName.Substring(10);
					int result2 = -1;
					if (int.TryParse(s2, out result2))
					{
						string[] controllerIdList = GetControllerIdList();
						if (controllerIdList != null && result2 >= 0 && result2 < controllerIdList.Length)
						{
							empty = string.Format(ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_Controller_Tooltip, controllerIdList[result2]);
						}
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return empty;
		}

		private bool IsFeedStream(Connection connection)
		{
			if (connection != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)connection).Name != null)
			{
				return ((FrameworkElement)(object)connection).Name.StartsWith("FeedStream_");
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsControllerStream(Connection connection)
		{
			if (connection != null)
			{
				if ((!((FrameworkElement)(object)connection).Name.StartsWith("Controller") || (!((FrameworkElement)(object)connection).Name.EndsWith("PV") && !((FrameworkElement)(object)connection).Name.EndsWith("MV"))) && (connection.SourcePort == null || connection.SourcePort.Ctrl == null || !IsController(connection.SourcePort.Ctrl)))
				{
					if (connection.SinkPort != null && connection.SinkPort.Ctrl != null)
					{
						return IsController(connection.SinkPort.Ctrl);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsController(IconCtrl icon)
		{
			if (icon == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsController(((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name);
		}

		private bool IsController(string sIconName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sIconName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sIconName.Length >= 10)
			{
				return sIconName.StartsWith("Controller");
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsReceiver(string sIconName)
		{
			if (sIconName.Length >= 8)
			{
				return sIconName.Substring(0, 8) == "Receiver";
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void LoadTemplateIcon()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(assemblyName);
			stringBuilder.Append(".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Composed.");
			stringBuilder.Append(potOrientation.ToString());
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			if (hasColumn)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Column");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("NoColumn");
			}
			if (hasSecondCondenser)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Partial2");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(".xml");
			if (hasPotOnly)
			{
				stringBuilder.Clear();
				stringBuilder.Append(assemblyName + ".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Composed.");
				stringBuilder.Append(potOrientation.ToString());
				stringBuilder.Append("Pot.xml");
			}
			try
			{
				using StreamReader txtReader = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(stringBuilder.ToString()));
				xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
				SmartIconContainer.Open(xmlDocument, 2, 0.01);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for template icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
			}
		}

		private void SetUpReceivers()
		{
			try
			{
				object[] values = iconConfigWatcher.Values;
				int result = 0;
				if (!hasPotOnly || ((int)iconConfigWatcher.Values[4] <= 0 && (int)iconConfigWatcher.Values[4] < 2))
				{
					TryGetIntValue(values[4], ref result);
					AddReceivers(result);
					int? result2 = null;
					int? result3 = null;
					int? result4 = null;
					int? result5 = null;
					int? result6 = null;
					int? result7 = null;
					TryGetIntValue(values[14], ref result2);
					if (validPhases == ValidPhases.VaporLiquid)
					{
						TryGetIntValue(values[15], ref result4);
						TryGetIntValue(values[19], ref result5);
					}
					else
					{
						TryGetIntValue(values[16], ref result4);
						TryGetIntValue(values[17], ref result6);
						TryGetIntValue(values[20], ref result5);
						TryGetIntValue(values[21], ref result7);
					}
					TryGetIntValue(values[18], ref result3);
					ConnectReceivers(result2, result4, result6, result3, result5, result7);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error setting up receivers." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void AddReceivers(int numReceivers)
		{
			string name = assemblyName + ".BatchSepFlowsheet.Icons.Converted.Receiver.xml";
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = new XmlDocument();
			try
			{
				using StreamReader txtReader = new StreamReader(assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name));
				xmlDocument.Load(txtReader);
				new XmlNamespaceManager(xmlDocument.NameTable).AddNamespace("y", "http://localhost/pfs");
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Unable to load xml resource for receiver icon." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				return;
			}
			string text = "Pot;E;Right;" + (hasSecondCondenser ? "180" : "100");
			for (int i = 0; i < numReceivers; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text = "Receiver" + (i - 1) + ";E;Top;10";
				}
				IconCtrl obj = SmartIconContainer.AddIcon(xmlDocument, text.ToString());
				((FrameworkElement)(object)obj).Name = "Receiver" + i;
				obj.SetAnimationValue("ReceiverLabel", (i + 1).ToString());
			}
		}

		private void ConnectReceivers(int? c1VaporRecvr, int? c1Liquid1Recvr, int? c1Liquid2Recvr, int? c2VaporRecvr, int? c2Liquid1Recvr, int? c2Liquid2Recvr)
		{
			List<Port> list = new List<Port>();
			List<IconCtrl> icons = SmartIconContainer.Icons;
			if (icons == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IconCtrl item in icons.FindAll((IconCtrl icon) => ((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)icon).Name.StartsWith("Receiver")))
			{
				list.Add(item.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Top"));
			}
			IconCtrl val = FindIcon("RefluxSplitter");
			if (c1Liquid1Recvr.HasValue)
			{
				ConnectReceiver("Splitter_to_C1L1Receiver", val.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Bottom"), list[c1Liquid1Recvr.Value - 1]);
				if (validPhases == ValidPhases.VaporLiquidLiquid && c1Liquid2Recvr.HasValue && c1Liquid2Recvr.Value != c1Liquid1Recvr.Value)
				{
					ConnectReceiver("Splitter_to_C1L2Receiver", val.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Right"), list[c1Liquid2Recvr.Value - 1]);
				}
			}
			if (hasSecondCondenser)
			{
				IconCtrl val2 = FindIcon("Condenser2");
				if (validPhases == ValidPhases.VaporLiquid || (c2Liquid2Recvr.HasValue && c2Liquid2Recvr.Value == c2Liquid1Recvr.Value))
				{
					if (c2Liquid1Recvr.HasValue)
					{
						ConnectReceiver("C2_to_C2L1Receiver", val2.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Bottom"), list[c2Liquid1Recvr.Value - 1]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (c2Liquid1Recvr.HasValue)
					{
						ConnectReceiver("C2_to_C2L1Receiver", val2.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "BottomLeft"), list[c2Liquid1Recvr.Value - 1]);
					}
					if (c2Liquid2Recvr.HasValue)
					{
						ConnectReceiver("C2_to_C2L2Receiver", val2.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "BottomRight"), list[c2Liquid2Recvr.Value - 1]);
					}
				}
				if (iconConfigWatcher.Values[22].ToString() == "PARTIAL" && c2VaporRecvr.HasValue)
				{
					ConnectReceiver("C2_to_C2VaporReceiver", val2.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Top"), list[c2VaporRecvr.Value - 1]);
				}
			}
			else if (condenserSetting == CondenserSetting.Partial && c1VaporRecvr.HasValue)
			{
				IconCtrl val3 = FindIcon("Condenser1");
				ConnectReceiver("C1_to_C1VaporReceiver", val3.Ports.Find((Port port) => port.Name == "Top"), list[c1VaporRecvr.Value - 1]);
			}
			if (!hasRefluxDrum)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = iconConfigWatcher.Values[24];
			if (obj == null || !(obj.ToString().ToUpper() == "YES"))
			{
				return;
			}
			IconCtrl val4 = FindIcon("RefluxDrum");
			object obj2;
			int num;
			if (validPhases == ValidPhases.VaporLiquid)
			{
				obj2 = iconConfigWatcher.Values[25];
				if (obj2 == null)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Missing drum dump receiver value 1 in vapor-liquid phase.", (Category)3, (Priority)3);
					return;
				}
				num = int.Parse(obj2.ToString());
				SmartIconContainer.Connect(val4.FindPort("Right"), list[num - 1], false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
				return;
			}
			obj2 = iconConfigWatcher.Values[26];
			object obj3 = iconConfigWatcher.Values[27];
			if (obj2 == null || obj3 == null)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Missing drum dump receiver value(s) in vapor-liquid-liquid phase.", (Category)3, (Priority)3);
				return;
			}
			int num2;
			try
			{
				num = int.Parse(obj2.ToString());
				num2 = int.Parse(obj3.ToString());
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error parsing drum dump receiver value." + Environment.NewLine + ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)3);
				return;
			}
			SmartIconContainer.Connect(val4.FindPort("Right"), list[num - 1], false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
			if (num != num2)
			{
				SmartIconContainer.Connect(val4.FindPort("BottomRight"), list[num2 - 1], false, 0.0, true, "Black", 1.0, "", "", "");
			}
		}

		private void Icon_MouseEnterEvent(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IconCtrl mouseHoveredIcon = GetMouseHoveredIcon(sender, e);
			if (mouseHoveredIcon != null)
			{
				string text = Colors.Gold.ToString();
				mouseHoveredIcon.Highlight(text);
			}
		}

		private void Icon_MouseLeaveEvent(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IconCtrl mouseHoveredIcon = GetMouseHoveredIcon(sender, e);
			if (mouseHoveredIcon != null)
			{
				string text = Colors.White.ToString();
				if (IsController(((FrameworkElement)(object)mouseHoveredIcon).Name))
				{
					text = Colors.Transparent.ToString();
				}
				mouseHoveredIcon.Highlight(text);
			}
		}

		private IconCtrl GetMouseHoveredIcon(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			IconCtrl val = (IconCtrl)((sender is IconCtrl) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				string overlaysTargetIconName = GetOverlaysTargetIconName(((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name);
				val = FindIcon(overlaysTargetIconName);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private void Icon_IconEditorEvent(object sender, IconEditorEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IconCtrl val = (IconCtrl)sender;
			if (!(e.Event == "MouseEvent"))
			{
				return;
			}
			string overlaysTargetIconName = GetOverlaysTargetIconName(((FrameworkElement)(object)val).Name);
			string text = string.Empty;
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			switch (overlaysTargetIconName)
			{
			case "Column":
				text = ApwnResources.BrowserSetup;
				text2 = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_Setup_MMFHeader0;
				break;
			case "Condenser1":
				text = ApwnResources.BrowserSetup;
				text2 = ApwnResources.MMRadfrac_Setup_MMFHeader3;
				break;
			case "Condenser2":
				text = ApwnResources.BrowserSetup;
				text2 = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Condenser2;
				break;
			case "FullJacket":
			case "Coils":
			case "HX":
			case "PartialJacket":
				text = ApwnResources.Navigation_BrowserHeatTransfer;
				text2 = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_HeatXfer_Configuration;
				break;
			case "Pot":
				text = ApwnResources.BrowserSetup;
				text2 = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot;
				break;
			case "RefluxDrum":
				text = ApwnResources.BrowserSetup;
				text2 = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Reflux;
				break;
			default:
				if (IsReceiver(overlaysTargetIconName))
				{
					text = ApwnResources.BrowserSetup;
					text2 = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Streams;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!IsController(overlaysTargetIconName))
					{
						break;
					}
					string s = overlaysTargetIconName.Substring(10);
					int result = -1;
					if (int.TryParse(s, out result))
					{
						string[] controllerIdList = GetControllerIdList();
						if (controllerIdList != null && result >= 0 && result < controllerIdList.Length)
						{
							text = ApwnResources.Navigation_BrowserControllers + "." + controllerIdList[result];
							text2 = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Controllers_Connections;
						}
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			string text3 = string.Empty;
			string[] array = _sBlockDataPath.Split('.');
			if (array == null || array.Length < 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 2; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != "Data")
				{
					text3 = text3 + array[i] + ".";
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode("Simulation!" + text3 + text, text2, false);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeIconDisplay()
		{
			CheckIfUseAnimation();
			_bAnimationsEnabled = MmgSor.MMinqrsl() != 0;
			if (savedFlowsheet == null || _sCurBlockPath == null || _sCurBlockPath != BlockPath)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
				LoadIcons();
				if (_isPauseButtonEnabled)
				{
					_bAnimationsEnabled = true;
					UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText();
					UpdateVisualsDuringRun();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				GetConfigurationInfo();
				LoadSavedFlowsheet();
				RemoveControllers();
				AddControllers();
				PostLoadFlowsheet();
				UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText(reset: true);
			}
			_sCurBlockPath = BlockPath;
		}

		private void SubscribeToCXSCaseMessages()
		{
			CxsCase val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Message += cxsCase_MessageHandler;
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFromCXSCaseMessages()
		{
			CxsCase val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Message -= cxsCase_MessageHandler;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeToAggregatedEvents()
		{
			IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunStartedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunStartedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationRunStartedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunStartedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationReinitializedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationReinitializedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationReinitializedEventArgs>)OnSimulationReinitializedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunPausedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunPausedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationRunPausedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunPausedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunCompletedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunCompletedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunFailedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunFailedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs>)OnObjectRenameEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs>)OnPauseButtonClickEvent);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFromAggregatedEvents()
		{
			IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunStartedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunStartedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunStartedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunStartedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationReinitializedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationReinitializedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationReinitializedEventArgs>)OnSimulationReinitializedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunPausedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunPausedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunPausedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunPausedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunCompletedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunCompletedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<SimulationRunFailedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<SimulationRunFailedEventArgs>)OnSimulationRunFailedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs>)OnObjectRenameEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs>)OnPauseButtonClickEvent);
		}

		private void OnObjectRenameEvent(ObjectRenamedAnywhereEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(args.OldName) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(args.NewName) && args.IsCxsPathImpacted(_sCurBlockPath))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (args.OldPath.Contains(".Controllers.") || _sCurBlockPath != BlockPath)
				{
					_sCurBlockPath = BlockPath;
					DisposeOfAllWatches();
					((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
					LoadIcons();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnPauseButtonClickEvent(BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args != null && _isPauseButtonEnabled)
			{
				IsPauseChecked = args.IsPaused;
			}
		}

		private void OnSimulationRunStartedEvent(SimulationRunStartedEventArgs e)
		{
			_bAnimationsEnabled = true;
			SetPausedFlag(0);
		}

		private void OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			_bAnimationsEnabled = true;
			UpdatePauseButton();
			UpdateVisualsDuringRun();
		}

		private void UpdatePauseButton(bool IsQuit = false)
		{
			if (IsQuit)
			{
				IsPauseButtonEnabled = false;
				IsPauseChecked = false;
				return;
			}
			CxsCase val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = val.BatchGet(_sBlockDataPath + ".CC Nodes.CCRUNNING", "value");
			if (obj != null && (int)obj == 1)
			{
				IsPauseButtonEnabled = true;
				object obj2 = val.BatchGet(_sBlockDataPath + ".Input.ISPAUSED", "value");
				if (obj2 != null && (string)obj2 == "YES")
				{
					IsPauseChecked = true;
				}
				else
				{
					IsPauseChecked = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IsPauseButtonEnabled = false;
				IsPauseChecked = false;
			}
		}

		private void SetPausedFlag(int iPaused)
		{
			CxsCase val = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			if (val != null && val.BatchGet(_sBlockDataPath + ".Input.ISPAUSED", "value") != null)
			{
				val.BatchSet(_sBlockDataPath + ".Input.ISPAUSED", "value", (object)((iPaused == 1) ? "YES" : "NO"));
			}
		}

		private void GetPauseButtonStatus()
		{
			if (IsPauseButtonEnabled)
			{
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.ISPAUSED", "value")) == "YES")
				{
					IsPauseChecked = true;
				}
				else
				{
					IsPauseChecked = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisualsDuringRun()
		{
			if (!useAnimation || !_bAnimationsEnabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_Flowsheet))
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					UpdateIconOverlays_ADS();
					UpdateReceiverConnectionsDuringRun_ADS();
					UpdateStreamAnimations_ADS();
					UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText();
					SaveHeatOverlayValues();
					SaveFlowsheet();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(ex.ToString(), (Category)1, (Priority)2);
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Render);
		}

		private void ResetHeatOverlayInfo()
		{
			hInfo = null;
			DataProvider.Reinitialize();
		}

		private void OnSimulationReinitializedEvent(SimulationReinitializedEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_Flowsheet)
				{
					_bAnimationsEnabled = false;
					ResetHeatOverlayInfo();
					LoadIcons();
					UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText(reset: true);
					CheckIfUseAnimation();
				}
			}, DispatcherPriority.Loaded);
		}

		private void OnSimulationRunPausedEvent(SimulationRunPausedEventArgs obj)
		{
			SaveFlowsheet();
		}

		private void OnSimulationRunCompletedEvent(SimulationRunCompletedEventArgs obj)
		{
			StopAnimationsAndSaveFlowsheet();
		}

		private void OnSimulationRunFailedEvent(SimulationRunFailedEventArgs obj)
		{
			StopAnimationsAndSaveFlowsheet();
		}

		private void cxsCase_MessageHandler(object sender, CxsMessageEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			foreach (CxsMessage message in e.Messages)
			{
				CxsMessage current = message;
				if ((int)((CxsMessage)(ref current)).MessageType == 0)
				{
					string text = ((CxsMessage)(ref current)).Text;
					if (text.StartsWith("Initialization as Empty completed.") || text.StartsWith("Initialization at Total reflux completed successfully") || text.StartsWith("Initialization completed successfully"))
					{
						UpdateVisualsDuringRun();
					}
					else if (text.StartsWith("The run has completed"))
					{
						StopAnimationsAndSaveFlowsheet();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void CheckIfUseAnimation()
		{
			useAnimation = (int)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<CxsCase>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).BatchGet("Top.appModelV8.Settings.animation", "value") == 1;
		}

		private void UpdateReceiverConnectionsDuringRun()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			foreach (string key in receiverEOMappings.Keys)
			{
				string eODouble = GetEODouble(key);
				if (eODouble != receiverEOMappings[key])
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				dictionary.Add(key, eODouble);
			}
			receiverEOMappings = dictionary;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (Connection item in SmartIconContainer.Connections.FindAll((Connection c) => c.SinkPort != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)c.SinkPort.Ctrl).Name.StartsWith("Receiver")))
				{
					SmartIconContainer.DeleteConnection(item);
				}
				int? result = null;
				int? result2 = null;
				int? result3 = null;
				int? result4 = null;
				int? result5 = null;
				int? result6 = null;
				TryGetIntValue(receiverEOMappings["VAPORRECV"], ref result);
				TryGetIntValue((validPhases == ValidPhases.VaporLiquid) ? receiverEOMappings["LIQUIDRECV"] : receiverEOMappings["LIQUID1RECV"], ref result2);
				TryGetIntValue(receiverEOMappings["LIQUID2RECV"], ref result3);
				TryGetIntValue(receiverEOMappings["C2VAPORRECV"], ref result4);
				TryGetIntValue((validPhases == ValidPhases.VaporLiquid) ? receiverEOMappings["C2LIQUIDRECV"] : receiverEOMappings["C2LIQ1RECV"], ref result5);
				TryGetIntValue(receiverEOMappings["C2LIQ2RECV"], ref result6);
				ConnectReceivers(result, result2, result3, result4, result5, result6);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating receivers during run." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIconOverlays()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UpdateTemperatureProfile();
				UpdateLiquidLevels();
				if (hasJacket && potOrientation == Orientation.Vertical)
				{
					UpdateHeatTransferColor("JacketHeatOverlay");
				}
				if (hasCoils)
				{
					UpdateHeatTransferColor("CoilsHeatOverlay");
				}
				if (hasHX)
				{

		private void UpdateTemperatureProfile()
		{
			IconCtrl val = null;
			if (hasColumn)
			{
				val = FindIcon("ColumnHeatOverlay");
				if (val == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			IconCtrl val2 = FindIcon("PotHeatOverlay");
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string eODouble = GetEODouble("T(" + numStages + ")");
			string eODouble2 = GetEODouble("T(2)");
			if (double.TryParse(eODouble, out var result) && double.TryParse(eODouble2, out var result2))
			{
				double num = 25.0;
				double num2 = 125.0;
				double num3 = num2 - num;
				double num4 = 0.3;
				double num5 = Math.Max(num, Math.Min(num2, result));
				double num6 = Math.Max(num, Math.Min(num2, result2));
				int num7 = (int)(255.0 * (num6 - num) / num3);
				Color color = new Color
				{
					A = (byte)(255.0 * num4),
					R = (byte)num7,
					B = (byte)(255 - num7)
				};
				int num8 = (int)(255.0 * (num5 - num) / num3);
				Color color2 = new Color
				{
					A = (byte)(255.0 * num4),
					R = (byte)num8,
					B = (byte)(255 - num8)
				};

				{
					val.SetAnimationValue("TopColor", color.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

				}
				val2.SetAnimationValue("BottomColor", color2.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			}
		}

					return;

				{
					if (jacketHeating)

				if (hasHX)

					}
					else if (hxCooling)
					{
						mode = 0.0;
					}
					UpdateHeatTransferColor_ADS("HXHeatOverlay", mode);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log("Error updating icon overlays." + Environment.NewLine + ex, (Category)1, (Priority)2);
			}
		}

		private string GetEODouble(string variableName)
		{
			string eOBlockVariables = EOVariableUtils.GetEOBlockVariables(BlockName, variableName);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(eOBlockVariables))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = eOBlockVariables.Split(new string[2] { "\n", "=" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = array[1];
			if (!double.TryParse(text, out var _))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetEOValue(string variableName)
		{
			string eOBlockVariables = EOVariableUtils.GetEOBlockVariables(BlockName, variableName);
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(eOBlockVariables))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] array = eOBlockVariables.Split(new string[2] { "\n", "=" }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return array[1];
		}

		private string GetOverlaysTargetIconName(string baseIconName)
		{
			string result = baseIconName;
			int val = baseIconName.IndexOf("HeatOverlay");
			int val2 = baseIconName.IndexOf("LiquidLevel");
			int num = Math.Max(val, val2);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				result = baseIconName.Substring(0, num);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetIconAnimationValue(string iconName, string key)
		{
			return FindIcon(iconName)?.GetAnimationValue(key);
		}

		private IconCtrl FindIcon(string iconName)
		{
			IconCtrl obj = SmartIconContainer.FindIcon(iconName);
			string text = "Unable to find icon '" + iconName + "'.";
			if (obj == null)
			{
				SystemEnvironment.Logger.Log(text, (Category)3, (Priority)3);
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private Connection ConnectReceiver(string connectionName, Port sourcePort, Port sinkPort, bool align = false, double distance = 0.0, bool arrow = true, string color = "Black", double thickness = 1.0, string dash = "")
		{
			Connection obj = SmartIconContainer.Connect(sourcePort, sinkPort, align, distance, arrow, color, thickness, dash, "", "");
			connectionName = connectionName.Replace('-', '_');
			obj.SetName(connectionName);
			return obj;
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentOperatingStepText(bool reset = false)
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_Flowsheet mMBatchSep_Flowsheet) || !useAnimation)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (reset || !_bAnimationsEnabled)
			{
				mMBatchSep_Flowsheet.CurrentOperatingStepText.Text = string.Empty;
				_curOperatingStep = string.Empty;
				return;
			}
			string currentOperatingStepName = DataProvider.GetCurrentOperatingStepName();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentOperatingStepName) && currentOperatingStepName != _curOperatingStep)
			{
				mMBatchSep_Flowsheet.CurrentOperatingStepText.Text = ApwnResources.BatchSepFlowsheet_CurrentOperatingStep + currentOperatingStepName;
				_curOperatingStep = currentOperatingStepName;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentOperatingStepName) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_curOperatingStep))
			{
				mMBatchSep_Flowsheet.CurrentOperatingStepText.Text = string.Empty;
				_curOperatingStep = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeOfAllWatches()
		{
			if (iconConfigWatcher != null)
			{
				iconConfigWatcher.ValuesChanged -= iconWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				iconConfigWatcher.Unload();
				iconConfigWatcher = null;
			}
			if (iconControllerConfigWatcher != null)
			{
				iconControllerConfigWatcher.ValuesChanged -= iconWatcher_ControllerConfigChanged;
				iconControllerConfigWatcher.Unload();
				iconControllerConfigWatcher = null;
			}
			if (iconControllerSettingsWatcher != null)
			{
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher.ValuesChanged -= iconWatcher_ControllerSettingsChanged;
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher.Unload();
				iconControllerSettingsWatcher = null;
			}
			if (feedStreamsWatcher != null)
			{
				feedStreamsWatcher.ValuesChanged -= feedStreamsWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				feedStreamsWatcher.ValuesChanged -= feedStreamsWatcher_ValuesChanged;
				feedStreamsWatcher.Unload();
				feedStreamsWatcher = null;
			}
			DisposeOfFeedStreamsStagesWatcher();
		}

		public override void Unload()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View != null)
			{
				ClearTheContainer();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).Unload();
			DisposeOfAllWatches();
			UnsubscribeFromAggregatedEvents();
			UnsubscribeFromCXSCaseMessages();
		}

		private void DumpFlowsheet()
		{
			string innerXml = SmartIconContainer.Save().InnerXml;
			string text = "C:\\temp";
			if (!Directory.Exists(text))
			{
				Directory.CreateDirectory(text);
			}
			string text2 = DateTime.Now.ToString("MMddHHmmss");
			File.WriteAllText(System.IO.Path.Combine(text, "bsflowsheet_" + text2 + ".xml"), innerXml);
		}
	}

			{
				get
				{
					return _cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue;
				}
				set
				{
					if (_cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue != value && value != null)
					{
						_cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue = value;
						((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue");
						SetSCLocation(_cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue);
					}
				}
			}

			public grdProcessVariable_Data_ItemTemplate()
			{
				SetSCSelectedValue();
			}

			protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
			{
				if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (pd.Name == "ProcessVariable_MultiMap" && subPropertyName == "Value")
				{
					string value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TRIGGER.@id.@y", "value"));
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
					{
						currentProcessVariableValue = value;
					}
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
			}

			private void SetSCLocation(string scLocation)
			{
				if (scLocation == null)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SC_LOC.@id.@y", "value", (object)null);
					ClearPreviousLocationValues();
					return;
				}
				string Value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SC_LOC.@id.@y", "value"));
				VarItem varItem = SCLocationList.Find((VarItem x) => x.Value == Value);
				VarItem varItem2 = SCLocationList.Find((VarItem x) => x.Display == scLocation);
				if (varItem2 != null && (varItem == null || (varItem != null && cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue != varItem.Display)))
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.SC_LOC.@id.@y", "value", (object)varItem2.Value);
				}
			}

			private void SetSCSelectedValue()
			{
				string Value = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SC_LOC.@id.@y", "value"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Value))
				{
					VarItem varItem = SCLocationList.Find((VarItem x) => x.Value == Value);
					if (varItem != null)
					{
						cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue = varItem.Display;
						((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarSCLoc_SelectedValue");
					}
				}
			}

			private ObservableCollection<int> GetIds(string varName)
			{
				ObservableCollection<int> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<int>();
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("id"));
				string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y"));
				if (text == null && text2 == null)
				{
					return observableCollection;
				}
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input." + varName, "child_ids"));
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (text.ToUpper() == array[i].ToUpper())
					{
						observableCollection.Add(i + 1);
						break;
					}
				}
				int item = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32((object)text2.Replace("#", "")).Value + 1;
				observableCollection.Add(item);
				return observableCollection;
			}

			protected override void OnUpdateData()
			{
				bool flag = false;
				ObservableCollection<int> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<int>();
				SetSCSelectedValue();
				string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TRIGGER.@id.@y", "value"));
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentProcessVariableValue) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && currentProcessVariableValue != text)
				{
					string blockId = PM.BlockId;
					string text2 = "OP-STEP2";
					observableCollection = GetIds("TRIGGERLOC");
					SmgeHelper.SetBatchSepVariableValue2(blockId, text2, "TRIG-TEMP", observableCollection[0], observableCollection[1], (string)null);
					SmgeHelper.SetBatchSepVariableValue2(blockId, text2, "TRIG-PRES", observableCollection[0], observableCollection[1], (string)null);

					SmgeHelper.SetBatchSepVariableValue2(blockId, text2, "TRIG-MOLEHD", observableCollection[0], observableCollection[1], (string)null);
					SmgeHelper.SetBatchSepVariableValue2(blockId, text2, "TRIG-VOL", observableCollection[0], observableCollection[1], (string)null);
					SmgeHelper.SetBatchSepVariableValue2(blockId, text2, "TRIG-COMP", observableCollection[0], observableCollection[1], (string)null);
					currentProcessVariableValue = text;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
					((MMViewModel)this).UpdateDisplay((object)null);
				}
				((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			}

		private void SetSCLocationList()
		{
			_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Clear();
			string blockId = BlockId;
			string batchSepVariableValue = SmgeHelper.GetBatchSepVariableValue(blockId, "CONFIG", 4);
			if (SmgeHelper.GetBatchSepVariableValue(blockId, "CONDENSER", 4) == "PARTIAL2" && batchSepVariableValue == "COLUMN")
			{
				_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_2Conderser);
			}
			if (batchSepVariableValue == "COLUMN")
			{
				_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_Conderser);
				_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_DisRec);
				if (SmgeHelper.GetBatchSepVariableValue(blockId, "REFLUXDRUM", 4) == "YES")
				{
					_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_ReflumDrum);
				}
			}
			_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_Pot);
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.@parent.@parent.@parent.Input.SDRECV_STRM", "has_children"));
			if (num.HasValue && num == 1)
			{
				_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_SideDrec);
			}
			int? num2 = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32((object)SmgeHelper.GetBatchSepVariableValue(blockId, "NSTAGE", 1));
			if (num2.HasValue && num2 >= 3 && batchSepVariableValue == "COLUMN")
			{
				_cboVarSCLoc_var2.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_CboVar_Stage);
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("cboVarSCLoc_var2");
		}

		private void cmdDelete_Command_Execute(object args)
		{
			if (args != null)
			{
				int num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32((object)args.ToString().Substring(1)) ?? 0;
				string item = string.Format(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_Row + " {0}", num + 1);
				((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.RAMPTIME.@id"), (IEnumerable<int>)new Collection<int> { num }, (IEnumerable<string>)new Collection<string> { item }, false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (SelectedRowIndexes.Count > 0)
				{
					_preSelectedRowIndexes = SelectedRowIndexes.ToList();
				}
				else if (_preSelectedRowIndexes != null)
				{
					foreach (int preSelectedRowIndex in _preSelectedRowIndexes)
					{
						SelectedRowIndexes.Add(preSelectedRowIndex);
					}
				}
				IOrderedEnumerable<int> orderedEnumerable = SelectedRowIndexes.OrderBy((int index) => index);
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable = from index in SelectedRowIndexes
					orderby index
					select string.Format(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_OpStep_Config_Row + " {0}", index + 1);
				GetSelectedIds().ToArray();
				((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.Input.RAMPTIME.@id"), (IEnumerable<int>)orderedEnumerable, enumerable, false);
			}
			if (SelectedRowIndexes != null)
			{
				SelectedRowIndexes.Clear();
			}
		}

		private bool cmdDelete_Command_CanExecute(object args)
		{
			if (args == null && SelectedRowIndexes != null && SelectedRowIndexes.Count == 1 && grdOperatingChanges_Data is IList list && SelectedRowIndexes[0] == list.Count - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = grdOperatingChanges_Data as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				if (selectedRowIndex >= 0 && selectedRowIndex < gridData.Count)
				{
					yield return $"#{selectedRowIndex}";
				}
			}
		}

		private void grdOperatingChangesRowDoubleClickCommand_Executed(object obj)
		{
		}

		private void cmdDeletePV_Command_Execute(object args)
		{
			if (args != null)

			{

		}

		private bool cmdDeletePV_Command_CanExecute(object args)

			if (args == null && SelectedRowIndexesPV != null && SelectedRowIndexesPV.Count == 1 && grdProcessVariable_Data is IList list && SelectedRowIndexesPV[0] == list.Count - 1)

				return false;
			}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIdsPV()
		{
			IList gridData = grdProcessVariable_Data as IList;
			foreach (int item in SelectedRowIndexesPV)

					yield return $"#{item}";
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetBlockID()
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main").Replace("Top.appModelV8.", string.Empty);
			int num = text.LastIndexOf("Blocks.", text.Length - 1, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
			int num2 = text.IndexOf(".", num + 7);
			if (num2 == -1)

		private string CreateNewVariableName(string name, string suffix)
		{
			if (name.Length < 8 - suffix.Length)
			{
				return name + suffix;
			}
			return name.Substring(0, 8 - suffix.Length) + suffix;
		}

			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.InvokeAction("Top.appModelV8.Custom Actions", "CAClearCache", false, (object[])null);

			}
		}

		private void SwitchOrder(int oldIndex, int newIndex)
		{
			string text = ((!(CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.@parent.@parent.Input.REORDER", "value")) == "YES")) ? "YES" : "NO");
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.@parent.@parent.Input.REORDER", "value", (object)text);
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < GetRowCount(); i++)
			{
				if (i == oldIndex)
				{
					list.Add(newIndex);
				}
				else if (i == newIndex)
				{
					list.Add(oldIndex);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(i);
				}
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).ReorderChildren("@main", (IEnumerable<int>)list);
			SelectedRowIndexes = new ObservableCollection<int>(new int[1] { newIndex });
			RefreshButtonStatus();
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool hasResults = HasResults;
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab0.Accessible = hasResults;
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab1.Accessible = hasResults;
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab2.Accessible = hasResults;
			if (!useReactions)
			{
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.UseReactions", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val.success && val.value != null)
				{
					useReactions = (bool)val.value;
				}
			}
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab3.Accessible = hasResults && useReactions;
			if (!mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab3.Accessible.HasValue || !mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab3.Accessible.Value)
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab3.Prompt = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Results_ReactionsTab_DisabledPrompt;
			}
			else
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab3.Prompt = null;
			}
			if (!isCalc)
			{
				AccessorElement val2 = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.CalcProps", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val2.success && val2.value != null)
				{
					isCalc = (bool)val2.value;
				}
			}
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab4.Accessible = hasResults && isCalc;
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.InternalsSections", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			if (adsArrayData == null || adsArrayData.Count() == 0)
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab5.Accessible = false;
				mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab5.Prompt = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Results_FloodingTab_DisabledPrompt;
				return;
			}
			string[] array = adsArrayData;
			foreach (string arg in array)
			{
				adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, $"@main.SharedData.InternalsSections.{arg}.CalcFlood", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (adbElement != null && adbElement.value != null && (adbElement.value as string).ToUpper() == "YES")
				{
					mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab5.Accessible = true;
					mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab5.Prompt = null;
					return;
				}
			}
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab5.Accessible = false;
			mMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults.tab5.Prompt = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Results_FloodingTab_DisabledPrompt;
		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			SetStagesIndexAndCount();
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (SelectedOperatingStep == null && _operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 1)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			else if (_operatingStepIditems != null && !_operatingStepIditems.Contains(SelectedOperatingStep))
			{
				if (_operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = null;
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_FloodProfileListNo", (object)ProfileListNo);
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdStageFlooding_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeStageFlooding_GridData");
		}

		protected override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_Flooding view = _view;
			if (view != null)
			{
				DispatcherExtensions.BeginInvokeOnce(((DispatcherObject)(object)view).Dispatcher, (Action)RefreshGrid);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (base.OperatingStepIds != null && base.OperatingStepIds.Count > 1)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = base.OperatingStepIds[0];
			}
			_view = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_Flooding;
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnPauseButtonClick(BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs e)
		{
			Collection<string> operatingStepIds = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (operatingStepIds != null && operatingStepIds.Count > 1)
			{
				OperatingStepIditems = operatingStepIds;
				if (SelectedOperatingStep == null)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = operatingStepIds[0];
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetStagesIndexAndCount()
		{
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.Stages", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			if (adsArrayData == null || adsArrayData.Count() == 0)
			{
				StageStartIndex = 0;
				StageCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<int> enumerable = adsArrayData.Select((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				StageStartIndex = 0;
				StageCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			enumerable = enumerable.Where((int y) => y > 1);
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				StageStartIndex = 0;
				StageCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			StageStartIndex = enumerable.Min();
			StageCount = enumerable.Count();
			StageCount--;
			if (StageCount <= 0)
			{
				StageStartIndex = 0;
				StageCount = 0;
			}
		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}

		private bool NeedGetFloodingData()
		{
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.InternalsSections", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			if (adsArrayData == null || adsArrayData.Count() == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] array = adsArrayData;
			foreach (string arg in array)
			{
				adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, $"@main.SharedData.InternalsSections.{arg}.CalcFlood", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (adbElement != null && adbElement.value != null && (adbElement.value as string).ToUpper() == "YES")
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

					{

					}
				}
			}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("ProfilesResultHoldup_MultiMap.Value", (object)"ProfilesResultHoldup_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("Views_Selected.Value", (object)ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Holdup_View_Mole);
			}
			RefreshGrid();
			base.OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (_operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = true;
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "ProfilesResultHoldup_MultiMap.Value")) == "ProfilesResultHoldup_MultiMap_1")
			{
				UpdateColumnSet();
			}
			_view = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_Holdup;
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (SelectedOperatingStep == null && _operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			else if (_operatingStepIditems != null && !_operatingStepIditems.Contains(SelectedOperatingStep))
			{
				if (_operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = null;
				}
			}
			Collection<string> operatingStepIditems = _operatingStepIditems;
			if (operatingStepIditems != null && operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = true;
			}
			else
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = false;
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HoldupProfileListNo", (object)ProfileListNo, true);
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdStageHoldup_Step_GridData");
		}

		protected override void OnPauseButtonClick(BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs e)
		{
			Collection<string> operatingStepIds = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (operatingStepIds != null && operatingStepIds.Count > 0)
			{
				HaveOperatingSteps = true;
				OperatingStepIditems = operatingStepIds;
				if (SelectedOperatingStep == null)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = operatingStepIds[0];
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_Holdup view = _view;
			if (view != null)
			{
				DispatcherExtensions.BeginInvokeOnce(((DispatcherObject)(object)view).Dispatcher, (Action)RefreshGrid);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)

				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdStageHoldup_Step_GridData");
				UpdateColumnSet();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			if (!_hasCalData)
			{
				HasCalData = HasCalcPropsData();
			}
			if (!_hasCalData)
			{
				return;
			}
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			HasSteps = base.HasOperatingSteps;
			if (SelectedOperatingStep == null && _operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 1)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			else if (_operatingStepIditems != null && !_operatingStepIditems.Contains(SelectedOperatingStep))
			{
				if (_operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = null;
				}
			}

			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdStageProperties_Step_GridData");
		}

			public MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_TPFQ_ViewModel ParentVM => ((CxvViewModel)this).Parent as MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_TPFQ_ViewModel;

			public object Id_var
			{
				get
				{
					//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_008b: Expected O, but got Unknown
					string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y"));
					switch (text)
					{
					case "-1":
						text = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key0;
						break;
					case "0":
						text = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key1;
						break;
					case "1":
						text = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key2;
						break;
					default:
						if (text == ParentVM.StepGridLastIndex)
						{
							text = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key3;
						}
						break;
					}
					return (object)new CxvManualVariableData
					{
						Value = text,
						IsCalculated = true,
						IsReadOnly = true
					};
				}
			}

			protected override void OnUpdateData()
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_Temperature", (object)string.Format("T({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_Pressure", (object)string.Format("P({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HeatDuty", (object)string.Format("QNET({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_LiquidMoleFlow", (object)string.Format("FLOUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_LiquidMassFlow", (object)string.Format("FMLOUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_L1MoleFlow", (object)string.Format("FL1OUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_L1MassFlow", (object)string.Format("FML1OUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_L2MoleFlow", (object)string.Format("FL2OUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_L2MassFlow", (object)string.Format("FML2OUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_VaporMoleFlow", (object)string.Format("FVOUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_VaporMassFlow", (object)string.Format("FMVOUT({0})", ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("y")), true);
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Temperature_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("Pressure_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("HeatDuty_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("LiquidMoleFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("LiquidMassFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("L1MoleFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("L1MassFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("L2MoleFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("L2MassFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("VaporMoleFlow_var");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("VaporMassFlow_var");
				((CxvViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			}

			private object GetFilteredValue(CxvPropertyDeclaration cxvProperty)
			{
				if (!ParentVM.SelectedOperatingStepHasFinished)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((CxvViewModel)this).GetValue(cxvProperty);
			}
