		public double? OperatingStepEndTime
		{
			get
			{
				string text = $"@main.SharedData.OperatingSteps.{SelectedOperatingStep}.EndTime";
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				double? num = null;
				if (val.value != null)
				{
					num = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)val.unitrow, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value) ?? 0.0, "sec");
				}
				return CxsConverter.ValueToDouble((object)num);
			}
		}

		public string ProfileListNo
		{
			get
			{
				double? operatingStepEndTime = OperatingStepEndTime;
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val != null && val.value != null)
				{
					IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
					if (elementChildren != null && elementChildren.Count() > 0)
					{
						IEnumerable<string> enumerable = elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p));
						if (enumerable != null && enumerable.Count() > 0)
						{
							string text = "";
							foreach (string item in enumerable)
							{
								text = $"@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList.{item}.CurrentTime";
								val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
								if (val.value != null)
								{
									double? d = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)24, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value) ?? 0.0, "sec");
									if (DoubleValuesAreEqual(operatingStepEndTime, d))
									{
										return item;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return "";
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			base.OnUpdateData();
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("ProfilesResultTPFQ_MultiMap.Value", (object)"ProfilesResultTPFQ_MultiMap_1");
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("Views_Selected.Value", (object)ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_TPFQ_View_Mole);
			}
			RefreshGrid();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "ProfilesResultTPFQ_MultiMap.Value")) == "ProfilesResultTPFQ_MultiMap_1")
			{
				UpdateColumnSet();
			}
			_view = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_TPFQ;
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		protected override void OnPauseButtonClick(BatchSepFlowSheetPauseButtonClickedEventArgs e)
		{
			Collection<string> operatingStepIds = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (operatingStepIds != null && operatingStepIds.Count > 1)
			{
				OperatingStepIditems = operatingStepIds;
				if (SelectedOperatingStep == null)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = operatingStepIds[0];
				}
			}
		}

		private void RefreshGrid()
		{
			OperatingStepIditems = base.OperatingStepIds;
			if (SelectedOperatingStep == null && _operatingStepIditems != null && _operatingStepIditems.Count > 1)
			{
				SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
			}
			else if (_operatingStepIditems != null && !_operatingStepIditems.Contains(SelectedOperatingStep))
			{
				if (_operatingStepIditems.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = _operatingStepIditems[0];
				}
				else
				{
					SelectedOperatingStep = null;
				}
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_TPFQProfileListNo", (object)ProfileListNo, true);
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdStageTPFQ_Step_GridData");
		}

		protected override void OnSimulationIntegrationStep(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			MMBatchSep_AdsProfileResults_TPFQ view = _view;
			if (view != null)
			{
				DispatcherExtensions.BeginInvokeOnce(((DispatcherObject)(object)view).Dispatcher, (Action)RefreshGrid);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMMScrollAreaColumnSet(MMScrollAreaColumnSet set)
		{
			SelectedColumnData = set;
		}

		private void UpdateColumnSet()
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00eb: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_columnsetWatch != null)
			{
				_columnsetWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= _columnsetWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
				_columnsetWatch.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				_columnsetWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "Views_Selected.Value"));
			string arg = "Molar";
			string text2 = null;
			if (text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_TPFQ_View_Mole)
			{
				text2 = "StageName,Temperature,Pressure,HeatDuty,MolarLiquidFlow,MolarVapourFlow";
			}
			else if (text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_TPFQ_View_Mass)
			{
				text2 = "StageName,Temperature,Pressure,HeatDuty,MassLiquidFlow,MassVapourFlow";
				arg = "Mass";
			}
			else
			{
				text2 = "StageName,Temperature,Pressure,HeatDuty,MolarLiquidFlow,MolarVapourFlow";
			}
			bool? flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(ICxvViewDataContainerExtensions.ResolveViewPropertyPath((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "NotOneLiquid.Value"));
			if ((text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_TPFQ_View_Mole || text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_TPFQ_View_Mass) && flag == true)
			{
				text2 = string.Format("{0},{1}L1Flow,{1}L2Flow", text2, arg);
			}
			UpdateMMScrollAreaColumnSet(new MMScrollAreaColumnSet
			{
				FieldNames = text2
			});
			StageFieldSets = text2;
			if (!_columnsetWatch.IsEmpty)
			{
				_columnsetWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged += _columnsetWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
			}
			else
			{
				_columnsetWatch = null;
			}
		}

		{

				{

	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			switch (value as string)
			{
			case "-1":
				return ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key0;
			case "0":
				return ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key1;

				{
					return ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Index_Key3;
				}
				return CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(value);
			}
		}

						}

						}
						else
						{
							dataSource.Rows[i][5].Value = RefreshThreshold(varLstTimeProfileInfo, dataSource.Rows[i][6].ValueAsString, ref asCxsPath2);
						}
						dataSource.Rows[i][5].Tag = new CellDataPackage(dataSource.Rows[i][5].Value, asCxsPath2);
					}
					if (dataSource.Rows[i][0] == null)
					{
						dataSource.Rows[i][0] = DataRow.CreateDataCell((object)varLstTimeProfileInfo.Name, false, (IEnumerable)null, (CellUIType)0, (object)null, (Brush)null, (Type)null, (string)null, (string)null, (System.Windows.HorizontalAlignment?)null, (string)null, (Thickness?)null, (Brush)null, false);
					}
					varLstTimeProfileInfo.Unit = dataSource.Rows[i][4].ValueAsString;
					int asphysicalType = 0;
					string asCxsPath3 = "";
					object obj = RefreshValueAtStepEnd(varLstTimeProfileInfo, dataSource.Rows[i][4].ValueAsString, dataSource.Rows[i], ref asphysicalType, ref asCxsPath3);
					if (dataSource.Rows[i][3] == null)
					{

					}
					obj = ((!num.HasValue || num != 0.0) ? obj : null);

		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}

		private Collection<OperatingStepInfo> GetOperatingStepInfoCollection()
		{
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.OperatingSteps", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			if (adsArrayData == null || adsArrayData.Count() < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Collection<OperatingStepInfo> collection = new Collection<OperatingStepInfo>();
			OperatingStepInfo operatingStepInfo = null;
			string[] array = adsArrayData;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				string text2 = $"@main.SharedData.OperatingSteps.{text}.EndTime";
				operatingStepInfo = new OperatingStepInfo();
				operatingStepInfo.Name = text;
				operatingStepInfo.Path = text2;
				adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text2, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (adbElement != null && adbElement.success && adbElement.unitrow != 0)
				{
					operatingStepInfo.unitrow = adbElement.unitrow;
					operatingStepInfo.EndTimeUnit = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.GetDefaultDisplayUnits((object)adbElement.unitrow);
					operatingStepInfo.EndtimeUnitList = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.GetUnitsList((object)adbElement.unitrow);
					operatingStepInfo.EndTime = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)adbElement.unitrow, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(adbElement.value) ?? 0.0, operatingStepInfo.EndTimeUnit);
					collection.Add(operatingStepInfo);
				}
			}
			return collection;
		}

		private string GetSpecifiedUnits(int aiPhysicalType)
		{
			string result = "";
			switch (aiPhysicalType)
			{
			case 85:
				result = "fraction";
				break;
			case 18:
				result = "kg";
				break;
			case 51:
				result = "kmol";
				break;
			case 27:
				result = "cum";
				break;
			case 20:
				result = "bar";
				break;
			case 22:
				result = "C";
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string GetVarListTimeProfileID(string asOperatingStepName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asOperatingStepName))
			{
				return "";
			}
			string text = $"@main.SharedData.OperatingSteps.{asOperatingStepName}.EndTime";
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, text, ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || val.value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			double? d = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)val.unitrow, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value) ?? 0.0, "sec");
			val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val == null || val.value == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(val);
			if (adsArrayData != null && adsArrayData.Count() > 0)
			{
				string[] array = adsArrayData;
				foreach (string text2 in array)
				{
					val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, $"@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList.{text2}.CurrentTime", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
					if (val != null && val.value != null)
					{
						double? d2 = ((MMViewModel)this).AdbUnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)24, CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(val.value) ?? 0.0, "sec");
						if (DoubleValuesAreEqual(d, d2))
						{
							return text2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return "";
		}

		private Collection<VariableMapTriggerPathInfo> GetVariableAdsName(string sThresholdName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sThresholdName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = $"@main.Input.OPS_ENDCOND.{sThresholdName}";
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text, "value")) != "TRIGGER")
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text2 = $"@main.Input.SC_LOC.{sThresholdName}";
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text2, "child_ids"));
			if (array == null || array.Count() < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text3 = "";
			string text4 = "";
			string text5 = "";
			string text6 = "";
			Collection<VariableMapTriggerPathInfo> collection = new Collection<VariableMapTriggerPathInfo>();
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text7 in array2)
			{
				text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(text2 + "." + text7, "value"));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text8 = $"{sThresholdName}.{text7}";
				text4 = text3.ToUpper() switch
				{
					"DRECV" => CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TRIG_DISTREC." + text8, "value")), 
					"SDRECV" => CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TRIG_SDREC." + text8, "value")), 
					"STAGE" => CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TRIG_STAGE." + text8, "value")), 
					_ => "", 
				};
				text5 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TRIGGER." + text8, "value"));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string asCompName = "";
				text6 = text3.ToUpper() switch
				{
					"POT" => GetPotTriggerPath(text5, text8, ref asCompName), 
					"CONDENSER" => GetCondenserTriggerPath(text5, text8, ref asCompName), 
					"CONDENSER2" => GetCondenser2TriggerPath(text5, text8, ref asCompName), 
					"STAGE" => GetStageTriggerPath(text5, text8, text4, ref asCompName), 
					"DRUM" => GetDrumTriggerPath(text5, text8, ref asCompName), 
					"DRECV" => GetDistillateReceiverTriggerPath(text5, text8, text4, ref asCompName), 
					"SDRECV" => GetSideDrawReceiverTriggerPath(text5, text8, text4, ref asCompName), 
					_ => "", 
				};
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text6))
				{
					string text9 = "";
					text9 = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4)) ? $"{text3} {text4} {text5}" : $"{text3} {text5}");
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(asCompName))
					{
						text9 = $"{text9} {asCompName.ToUpper()}";
					}
					collection.Add(new VariableMapTriggerPathInfo(text9, text6.ToUpper()));
				}
			}
			return collection;
		}

		private string GetPotTriggerPath(string asTriggerValue, string asPath, ref string asCompName)
		{
			switch (asTriggerValue)
			{
			case "L-MASSFRAC":
				asCompName = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet($"@main.Input.TRIG_COMP.{asPath}", "value"));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asCompName))
				{
					return "";
				}
				return $"Pot_xm({asCompName})";
			case "L-MASSHLDUP":
				return "Pot_Mml";
			case "L-MOLEHLDUP":
				return "Pot_Ml";
			case "L-MOLEFRAC":
				asCompName = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet($"@main.Input.TRIG_COMP.{asPath}", "value"));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asCompName))
				{
					return "";
				}
				return $"Pot_x({asCompName})";
			case "L-VOL":
				return "Pot_Vl";
			case "PRESSURE":
				return "Pot_P";
			case "TEMPERATURE":
				return "Pot_T";
			case "S-MASSHLDUP":
				return "Pot_Mmsol";
			case "S-MOLEHLDUP":
				return "Pot_Msol";
			default:
				return "";
			}
		}

		private string GetCondenserTriggerPath(string asTriggerValue, string asPath, ref string asCompName)
		{
			switch (asTriggerValue)

					return "";
				}
				return $"Condenser_Zin({asCompName})";
			case "INLET-TEMP":
				return "Condenser.Tin";
			case "L-MASSFRAC":
				asCompName = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet($"@main.Input.TRIG_COMP.{asPath}", "value"));
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(asCompName))

					return "";

		private string GetCondenser2TriggerPath(string asTriggerValue, string asPath, ref string asCompName)
		{
			switch (asTriggerValue)

		public void onDataCopying(GridControlCopyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SummaryView != null && SummaryView.grdResultsSummary != null && ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider != null && ((FrameworkElement)(object)SummaryView.grdResultsSummary).IsLoaded)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				if (((GridControlEventArgs)e).GridControl.SelectedColumns.FirstOrDefault() != null)
				{
					GetLabelOfNonHeaderOnlyFields(stringBuilder, ((GridControlEventArgs)e).GridControl.SelectedColumns, SummaryView.grdResultsSummary);
					((GridControlEventArgs)e).GridControl.ClipboardCopyMode = (GridControlClipboardCopyMode)1;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(e.GenerateTextToCopy((List<IGridCellData>)null, (bool?)null, false));
				string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				string caseFullFileName = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath", (CxvPropertyWatch)null) as string;
				string applicationName = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.ApplicationName", (CxvPropertyWatch)null) as string;
				e.ClipboardContents.Add(System.Windows.Forms.DataFormats.Text, text);
				e.ClipboardContents.Add("CSV", ConvertToStream(GenerateCsvFormatContent(text)));
				e.ClipboardContents.Add("DatagridMetadata", ConvertToStream(GenerateDatagridMetadataFormatContent(SummaryView.grdResultsSummary, e)));
				e.ClipboardContents.Add("ASI Format", ConvertToStream(GenerateAsiFormatContent(SummaryView.grdResultsSummary, e.ResolvedIncludeHeader, caseFullFileName, applicationName)));
				e.ClipboardContents.Add("ASI File Format", ConvertToStream(GenerateAsiFileFormatContent(caseFullFileName, applicationName)));
				((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private static void GetLabelOfNonHeaderOnlyFields(StringBuilder sb, IEnumerable<DataColumn> selectedFields, GridControl gc)
		{
			if (sb == null || selectedFields == null || gc == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DataColumn> list = selectedFields.ToList();
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				DataColumn val = list[i];
				string value = "\"" + val.Header + "\"";
				sb.Append(value);
				if (i < list.Count - 1)
				{
					sb.Append('\t');
				}
			}
			sb.AppendLine();
		}

		private static MemoryStream ConvertToStream(string value)
		{
			return new MemoryStream(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value));
		}

		private static string GenerateCsvFormatContent(string text)
		{
			return text.Replace('\t', ',');
		}

		private static string GenerateDatagridMetadataFormatContent(GridControl gc, GridControlCopyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ResolvedIncludeHeader)
			{
				return "ColumnHeaderLineCount=1";
			}
			return " ";
		}

		{
			return ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionGridXml(CreateCellDataPackage(gc, includesHeader), caseFullFileName, applicationName);
		}

		private string CreateNewVariableName(string name, string suffix)
		{
			if (name.Length < 8 - suffix.Length)
			{
				return name + suffix;
			}
			return name.Substring(0, 8 - suffix.Length) + suffix;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			if (SelectedRowIndexes == null)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			IList gridData = grdChild_GridData as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				if (selectedRowIndex >= 0 && selectedRowIndex < gridData.Count)
				{
					grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate;
					yield return grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate.Id;
				}
			}
		}

		public PotGeometry PotGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (_potGeometry == null)
				{
					_potGeometry = new PotGeometry();
					_potGeometry.GeometryChanged += _potGeometry_InputChanged;
					_potGeometry.ClearRequested += _potGeometry_ClearRequested;
					_potGeometry.CutRequested += _potGeometry_CutRequested;
					_potGeometry.CopyRequested += _potGeometry_CopyRequested;
					_potGeometry.PasteRequested += _potGeometry_PasteRequested;
					_potGeometry.Dragging += _potGeometry_Dragging;
				}
				return _potGeometry;
			}
		}

		private void _potGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		private void _potGeometry_PasteRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (double.TryParse(ClipboardWrapper.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text).ToString(), out var result))
			{
				(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = result;
			}
		}

		private void _potGeometry_CopyRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GeometryVariable geometryVariable = sender as GeometryVariable;
			ClipboardHelper.CreateClipboard((ICollection<string>)new List<string> { "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(geometryVariable.DataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel") }, geometryVariable.Value.ToString(), ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
		}

		private void _potGeometry_CutRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GeometryVariable geometryVariable = sender as GeometryVariable;
			ClipboardHelper.CreateClipboard((ICollection<string>)new List<string> { "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(geometryVariable.DataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel") }, geometryVariable.Value.ToString(), ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
		}

		private void _potGeometry_ClearRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, "value", (string)null, (object)null);
			inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
		}

		private void _potGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_hasInitilized)
			{
				return;
			}
			InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
			object obj = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute);
			if (e.Value == null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value);
				inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (sender is GeometryVariable)
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute));
				}
			}
			else if (obj != null && obj.ToString() != e.Value.ToString())
			{
				if (!((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, e.Attribute, e.Value))
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(obj);
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				}
				else
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main.CC Nodes.RSPEC"));
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			Update(geometryCalculation: false);
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void Update(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_cxvPropertyWatch == null)
			{
				_cxvPropertyWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			else
			{
				_cxvPropertyWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
				_cxvPropertyWatch.Clear();
			}
			UpdateGeometry(geometryCalculation);
			_cxvPropertyWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged += CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateGeometry(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Diameter.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.TanTanLength.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.Volume.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.Volume.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.ConeHeight.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "uom_options"));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.ConeHeight.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.DishRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				PotGeometry.KnuckeRadiusRatio.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			PotGeometry.TopHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.TopHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.BottomHead.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(PotGeometry.BottomHead.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			PotGeometry.IsVertical = bool.Parse(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.ORIENTATION", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("HORIZONTAL", "False")
				.Replace("VERTICAL", "True"));
			PotGeometry.GeoSpec = (GeoSpec)Enum.Parse(typeof(GeoSpec), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_1", "DL")
				.Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_2", "DV")
				.Replace("ogrGeoSpec_MultiMapOption_3", "LV"));
			if (!PotGeometry.Diameter.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.LV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.TanTanLength.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DV)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			if (!PotGeometry.Volume.Value.HasValue)
			{
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
				if (PotGeometry.GeoSpec == GeoSpec.DL)
				{
					geometryCalculation = true;
				}
			}
			switch (PotGeometry.GeoSpec)
			{
			case GeoSpec.DL:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.DV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.LV:
				PotGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = false;
				PotGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				PotGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				PotGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				break;
			}
			PotGeometry.LoadCompleted = true;
			_hasInitilized = true;
			if (geometryCalculation && (lastSpec == PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString() || lastSpec == null))
			{
				PotGeometry.CalculateGeometry();
			}
			lastSpec = PotGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString();
		}

		private void CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Update(geometryCalculation: true);
		}

		private void cmdLoadVessel_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			new LoadVesselDialog(this).ShowDialog();
			UpdateGeometry(geometryCalculation: true);
		}

		private void cmdSaveVessel_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			new SaveVesselDialog(this).ShowDialog();
		}

		public RefluxGeometry RefluxGeometry
		{
			get
			{
				if (_refluxGeometry == null)
				{
					_refluxGeometry = new RefluxGeometry();
					_refluxGeometry.GeometryChanged += _refluxGeometry_InputChanged;
					_refluxGeometry.ClearRequested += _refluxGeometry_ClearRequested;
					_refluxGeometry.CutRequested += _refluxGeometry_CutRequested;
					_refluxGeometry.CopyRequested += _refluxGeometry_CopyRequested;
					_refluxGeometry.PasteRequested += _refluxGeometry_PasteRequested;
					_refluxGeometry.Dragging += _refluxGeometry_Dragging;
				}
				return _refluxGeometry;
			}
		}

		private void _refluxGeometry_Dragging(DependencyObject sender, DraggingEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = true;
			string caseFullFilePath = ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath;
			System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject = e.DataObject;
			MemoryStream asiFileXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiFileXml(caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiFileXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI File Format").Name, asiFileXml);
			}
			string asiSelectionXml = ClipboardHelper.GetAsiSelectionXml((ICollection<string>)new Collection<string> { GetCxsItemMoniker(e.GeometryVariable.DataPath) }, caseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
			if (asiSelectionXml != null)
			{
				dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.GetDataFormat("ASI Format").Name, asiSelectionXml);
			}
			double? value = e.GeometryVariable.Value;
			dataObject.SetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text, value.HasValue ? value.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
			DragDrop.DoDragDrop(sender, dataObject, System.Windows.DragDropEffects.Copy);
		}

		private string GetCxsItemMoniker(string dataPath)
		{
			return "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(dataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel");
		}

		private void _refluxGeometry_PasteRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (double.TryParse(ClipboardWrapper.GetData(System.Windows.DataFormats.Text).ToString(), out var result))
			{
				(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = result;
			}
		}

		private void _refluxGeometry_CopyRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GeometryVariable geometryVariable = sender as GeometryVariable;
			ClipboardHelper.CreateClipboard((ICollection<string>)new List<string> { "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(geometryVariable.DataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel") }, geometryVariable.Value.ToString(), ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
		}

		private void _refluxGeometry_CutRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			GeometryVariable geometryVariable = sender as GeometryVariable;
			ClipboardHelper.CreateClipboard((ICollection<string>)new List<string> { "cxs:" + ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath(geometryVariable.DataPath).Replace("appModelV8", "appModel") }, geometryVariable.Value.ToString(), ((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.Case.CaseFullFilePath, ((MMViewModel)this).GetProductName());
		}

		private void _refluxGeometry_ClearRequested(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InputVariable inputVariable = sender as InputVariable;
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(inputVariable.DataPath, "value", (string)null, (object)null);
			inputVariable.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
		}

		private void _refluxGeometry_InputChanged(object sender, InputChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			string dataPath = (sender as InputVariable).DataPath;
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(dataPath, "value"));
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(dataPath, "uom"));
			if (e.Value == null)
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(dataPath, "value", (object)null);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				Update(geometryCalculation: true);
			}
			else if ((e.Attribute == "value" && text != e.Value.ToString()) || (e.Attribute == "uom" && text2 != e.Value.ToString()))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				flag = ((!(e.Attribute == "value")) ? ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(dataPath, "value", e.Value.ToString(), (object)text) : ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet(dataPath, "value", e.Value));
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
				if (!flag)
				{
					(sender as GeometryVariable).Value = null;
					Update(geometryCalculation: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Update(geometryCalculation: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			Update(geometryCalculation: false);
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void Update(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (_cxvPropertyWatch == null)
			{
				_cxvPropertyWatch = new CxvPropertyWatch();
			}
			else
			{
				_cxvPropertyWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged -= CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
				_cxvPropertyWatch.Clear();
			}
			UpdateGeometry(geometryCalculation);
			_cxvPropertyWatch.PropertyDependencyChanged += CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateGeometry(bool geometryCalculation)
		{
			RefluxGeometry.Diameter.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			RefluxGeometry.Diameter.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			RefluxGeometry.Diameter.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "uom_options", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			else
			{
				RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
			}
			RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "uom_options", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			else
			{
				RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
			}
			RefluxGeometry.Volume.Value = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			RefluxGeometry.Volume.Units = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			RefluxGeometry.Volume.UnitsList = CxsConverter.ValueToUnitsCollection(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "uom_options", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch));
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataPath, "user_entered").ToString() == "1")
			{
				RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.UserInput;
			}
			else
			{
				RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Default;
			}
			RefluxGeometry.Head.Value = (HeadType)Enum.Parse(typeof(HeadType), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(RefluxGeometry.Head.DataPath, "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString());
			RefluxGeometry.IsVertical = bool.Parse(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.DRUM_ORIENT", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("HORIZONTAL", "False")
				.Replace("VERTICAL", "True"));
			RefluxGeometry.GeoSpec = (GeoSpec)Enum.Parse(typeof(GeoSpec), ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.DRUM_GEOM", "value", (string)null, _cxvPropertyWatch).ToString().Replace("ogrRefluxSpec_MultiMapOption_1", "DL")
				.Replace("ogrRefluxSpec_MultiMapOption_2", "DV")
				.Replace("ogrRefluxSpec_MultiMapOption_3", "LV"));
			switch (RefluxGeometry.GeoSpec)
			{
			case GeoSpec.DL:
				RefluxGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				RefluxGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = false;
				RefluxGeometry.Volume.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.DV:
				RefluxGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = true;
				RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = false;
				RefluxGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			case GeoSpec.LV:
				RefluxGeometry.Diameter.IsEnabled = false;
				RefluxGeometry.TanTanLength.IsEnabled = true;
				RefluxGeometry.Volume.IsEnabled = true;
				RefluxGeometry.Diameter.DataSource = DataSource.Calculated;
				break;
			}
			RefluxGeometry.LoadCompleted = true;
			if (geometryCalculation && lastSpec == RefluxGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString())
			{
				RefluxGeometry.CalculateGeometry();
			}
			lastSpec = RefluxGeometry.GeoSpec.ToString();
		}

		private void CxvPropertyWatch_PropertyDependencyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Update(geometryCalculation: true);
		}

		{
			get
			{
				new Collection<string>();
				AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.OperatingSteps", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (val == null || !val.success)
				{
					return false;
				}
				IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
				if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

			SetTabAccessible();
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			((CompositePresentationEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((CxvViewModel)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<SimulationIntegrationStepEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs>)OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent);
			SetTabAccessible();
			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewChanged();
		}

			((MMViewModel)this).OnViewClosed();
		}

		private void OnSimulationIntegrationStepEvent(SimulationIntegrationStepEventArgs e)
		{
			SetTabAccessible();
		}

		private void SetTabAccessible()
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool hasResults = HasResults;
			mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab0.Accessible = hasResults;
			mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab1.Accessible = hasResults;
			mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab2.Accessible = hasResults;
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CALCPROPS", "value")) == true && hasResults)
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab4.Accessible = true;
			}
			else
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab4.Accessible = false;
			}
			AccessorElement adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.InternalsSections", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			string[] adsArrayData = GetAdsArrayData(adbElement);
			if (adsArrayData == null || adsArrayData.Count() == 0)
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab3.Accessible = false;
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab3.Prompt = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Results_FloodingTab_DisabledPrompt;
				return;
			}
			object obj = tab3_var;
			CxvTabItemPropertyData val = (CxvTabItemPropertyData)((obj is CxvTabItemPropertyData) ? obj : null);
			string[] array = adsArrayData;
			foreach (string arg in array)
			{
				adbElement = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, $"@main.SharedData.InternalsSections.{arg}.CalcFlood", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
				if (adbElement != null && adbElement.value != null && (adbElement.value as string).ToUpper() == "YES" && val.Accessible == true)
				{
					mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab3.Accessible = true;
					mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab3.Prompt = null;
					return;
				}
			}
			mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab3.Accessible = false;
			mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles.tab3.Prompt = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Results_FloodingTab_DisabledPrompt;
		}

		private string[] GetAdsArrayData(AccessorElement adbElement)
		{
			if (adbElement == null || !adbElement.success)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, adbElement);
			if (elementChildren == null || elementChildren.Count() == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
		}
	}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				Locations_Selected = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Pot;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("Basis_var.Value", (object)ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Basis_Mole);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("View_var.Value", (object)ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Composition_View_Liquid);
			}
			SetVarListIndexAndCount();
			SetStageIndexAndCount();
			if (StageNumSelected <= 1 || StageNumSelected > StageItemUpperLimit)
			{
				StageNumSelected = StageItemUpperLimit;
			}
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.CONFG8", "value")) == false)
			{
				string locations_Selected = Locations_Selected;
				ObservableCollection<string> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<string> { ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Pot };
				if (HasSDReceiver)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_SDReceiver);
				}
				LocationCollection = observableCollection;
				if (LocationCollection.Contains(locations_Selected))
				{
					Locations_Selected = locations_Selected;
				}
				else
				{
					Locations_Selected = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Pot;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string locations_Selected2 = Locations_Selected;
				LocationCollection = oCollection;
				Locations_Selected = locations_Selected2;
			}
			ReceiverNumSelected = ReceiverItemUpperLimit;
			if (ReceiverNumSelected == 0)
			{
				ReceiverItemLowerLimit = 0;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ReceiverItemUpperLimit");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeProfilesComposition");
			RefreshValidPhases();
			base.OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "Basis_var" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("IsStageItemSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("StageNumSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ReceiverNumSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeProfilesComposition");
				UpdateVarParameters();
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "View_var" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("IsStageItemSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("StageNumSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdTimeProfilesComposition");
				UpdateVarParameters();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{
			MMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Composition mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Composition = ((MMViewModel)this).View as MMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Composition;
			if (((MMViewModelContainer)mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Composition).SimulatorStatus.IsRunning)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Composition.grdTimeProfilesComposition.IndexerPath = string.Empty;
			}
			UpdateVarParameters();
			base.OnViewChanged();
		}

		private void SetStageIndexAndCount()
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.NSTAGE", "value"));
			if (!num.HasValue || num < 2)
			{
				StageItemLowerLimit = 0;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 0;
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Stage);
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CONDENSER", "value"));
			HasSecondCondenser = text == "PARTIAL2";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.REFLUXDRUM", "value"));
			HasDrum = text2 == "YES";
			HasSDReceiver = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.NOSDREV", "value")) == 1;
			int num2 = 2;
			if (num.Value - 1 < num2)
			{
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Stage);
				StageItemLowerLimit = 1;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 1;
				return;
			}
			if (!oCollection.Contains(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Stage))
			{
				oCollection.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_Locations_Stage);
			}
			StageItemLowerLimit = 2;
			StageItemUpperLimit = num.Value - 1;
		}

		public int ReceiverItemUpperLimit
		{
			get
			{
				ReceiverItemLowerLimit = 0;
				string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList.#0.VarList", "child_ids"));
				if (array == null)
				{
					return DistillateReceiversCount.GetValueOrDefault();
				}
				new Collection<string>();
				string sBlock = "DISTRECV(";
				IEnumerable<string> enumerable = from sID in array
					where sID.StartsWith(sBlock)
					select sID.Replace(sBlock, "");
				string text = "";
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				foreach (string item in enumerable)
				{
					if (item.EndsWith("_MM"))
					{
						string[] array2 = item.Trim().Split('_');
						if (array2 == null || array2.Length != 2)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						text = array2[0];
						text = text.Replace(")", "");
						if (!list.Contains(text))
						{
							list.Add(text);
						}
					}
				}
				if (list == null || list.Count() == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				IEnumerable<int> enumerable2 = list.Select((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
				if (enumerable2 == null || enumerable2.Count() == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				ReceiverItemLowerLimit = enumerable2.Min();
				return enumerable2.Max();
			}
		}

					if (CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.CONFG8", "value")) == false)
					{
						return "1";
					}
					return (StageItemUpperLimit + 1).ToString();
				}
				if (locations_Selected == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Condenser)
				{
					return "1";
				}
				if (locations_Selected == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_2ndCondenser)
				{
					return "-1";
				}
				if (locations_Selected == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Refluxdrum)
				{
					return "0";
				}
				if (locations_Selected == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Stage)
				{
					return StageNumSelected.ToString();
				}
				if (locations_Selected == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Receiver)
				{
					return locations_Selected;
				}
				return _SelectedStageID;
			}
			set
			{
				_SelectedStageID = value;
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("SelectedStageID");
				UpdateVarParameters();
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.UpdateDataCache();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			if (((CxvViewModel)this).IsInitialUpdate)
			{
				Locations_Selected = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Pot;
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateViewPropertyPath("Basis_var.Value", (object)ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole);
				View_Selected = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_ProfileResults_Composition_View_Liquid;
			}
			SetVarListIndexAndCount();
			SetStageIndexAndCount();
			if (StageNumSelected <= 1 || StageNumSelected > StageItemUpperLimit)
			{
				StageNumSelected = StageItemUpperLimit;
			}
			if (CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.CONFG8", "value")) == false)
			{
				string locations_Selected = Locations_Selected;
				ObservableCollection<string> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<string> { ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Pot };
				if (HasSDReceiver)
				{
					observableCollection.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_SDReceiver);
				}
				LocationCollection = observableCollection;
				if (LocationCollection.Contains(locations_Selected))
				{
					Locations_Selected = locations_Selected;
				}
				else
				{
					Locations_Selected = ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Pot;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string locations_Selected2 = Locations_Selected;
				LocationCollection = oCollection;
				Locations_Selected = locations_Selected2;
			}
			ReceiverNumSelected = ReceiverItemUpperLimit;
			if (ReceiverNumSelected == 0)
			{
				ReceiverItemLowerLimit = 0;
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ReceiverItemUpperLimit");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdSDReceiverMass_GridData");
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdSDReceiverHoldUpMole_GridData");
			ResetValidPhases();
			base.OnUpdateData();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "Basis_var" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("IsStageItemSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("StageNumSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("ReceiverNumSelected");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdSDReceiverMass_GridData");
				((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("grdSDReceiverHoldUpMole_GridData");
				UpdateVarParameters();
				SetGridColumnsVisibility();
				RefreshReceiverADSGrid();
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "NotOneLiquid" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				SetGridColumnsVisibility();
			}
			else if (pd.Name == "View_var" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				UpdateVarParameters();
				SetGridColumnsVisibility();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		protected override void OnViewChanged()
		{

				_view.grdReceiverHoldup.IndexerPath = string.Empty;

		}

		private void SetStageIndexAndCount()
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.NSTAGE", "value"));
			if (!num.HasValue || num < 2)
			{
				StageItemLowerLimit = 0;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 0;
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Stage);
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CONDENSER", "value"));
			HasSecondCondenser = text == "PARTIAL2";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.REFLUXDRUM", "value"));
			HasDrum = text2 == "YES";
			HasSDReceiver = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.NOSDREV", "value")) == 1;
			int num2 = 2;
			if (num.Value - 1 < num2)
			{
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Stage);
				StageItemLowerLimit = 1;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 1;
				return;
			}
			if (!oCollection.Contains(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Stage))
			{
				oCollection.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Stage);
			}
			StageItemLowerLimit = 2;
			StageItemUpperLimit = num.Value - 1;
		}

			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);

				if (elementChildren != null)
				{
					enumerable = elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
				}
			}
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<int> enumerable2 = enumerable.Select((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
			if (enumerable2 == null || enumerable2.Count() == 0)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				VarListStartIndex = enumerable2.Min();
				VarListCount = enumerable2.Count();
			}
		}

		private string GetComponetName(string componetID, ref int rowNumber, bool isPot)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("Basis_var.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			string view_Selected = View_Selected;
			if (!isPot)
			{
				if (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole))
				{
					result = $"DISTRECV({ReceiverNumSelected})_MC({componetID})";
					rowNumber = 51;
				}
				else
				{
					result = $"DISTRECV({ReceiverNumSelected})_MMC({componetID})";
					rowNumber = 18;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (view_Selected.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_View_Liquid))
				{
					result = (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole) ? string.Format("POT_MLC({1})", ReceiverNumSelected, componetID) : $"POT_MMLC({componetID})");
				}
				if (view_Selected.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_View_Vapor))
				{
					result = (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole) ? string.Format("POT_MVC({1})", ReceiverNumSelected, componetID) : $"POT_MMVC({componetID})");
				}
				if (view_Selected.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_View_Liquid1))
				{
					result = (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole) ? string.Format("POT_ML1C({1})", ReceiverNumSelected, componetID) : $"POT_MML1C({componetID})");
				}
				if (view_Selected.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Composition_View_Liquid2))
				{
					result = (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole) ? string.Format("POT_ML2C({1})", ReceiverNumSelected, componetID) : $"POT_MML2C({componetID})");
				}
				if (view_Selected.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchOp_Results_HoldupComposition_GridHeader_Total))
				{
					result = (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole) ? string.Format("POT_MC({1})", ReceiverNumSelected, componetID) : $"POT_MMC({componetID})");
				}
				if (text.Equals(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole))
				{
					rowNumber = 51;
				}
				else
				{
					rowNumber = 18;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void SetGridColumnsVisibility()
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Holdup { grdTimeProfilesHoldup: not null } mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Holdup))
			{
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("Basis_var.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			bool flag = text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mole;
			bool flag2 = text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Mass;
			bool flag3 = text == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Basis_Volume;
			bool flag4 = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("NotOneLiquid.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null)) ?? false;
			foreach (AdsField field in mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Holdup.grdTimeProfilesHoldup.Fields)
			{
				double? num = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet(field.PropertyPath.Replace("@rowid", "0"), "value"));
				if (Locations_Selected == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Holdup_Locations_Pot)
				{
					if (field.Key == "time")
					{
						field.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
					if (field.Key == "l2VolumeHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag3 || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					if (field.Key == "l1VolumeHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag3 || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					if (field.Key == "vaporVolumeHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag3 || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					if (field.Key == "liquidVolumeHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag3 || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					if (field.Key.Contains("Pot_"))
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!(flag || flag2) || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					if (field.Key.Contains("Total"))
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!(flag || flag2) || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					if (field.Key == "liquidMolarHoldup" || field.Key == "liquidMassHoldup" || field.Key == "vaporMolarHoldup" || field.Key == "vaporMassHoldup" || field.Key == "l1MolarHoldup" || field.Key == "l1MassHoldup" || field.Key == "l2MolarHoldup" || field.Key == "l2MassHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (field.Key == "time")
					{
						field.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
					}
					if (field.Key == "liquidMolarHoldup" || field.Key == "vaporMolarHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					else if (field.Key == "liquidMassHoldup" || field.Key == "vaporMassHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag2 || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					else if (field.Key == "liquidVolumeHoldup" || field.Key == "vaporVolumeHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!flag3 || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					else if (field.Key == "l1MolarHoldup" || field.Key == "l2MolarHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!(flag && flag4) || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					else if (field.Key == "l1MassHoldup" || field.Key == "l2MassHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!(flag2 && flag4) || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					else if (field.Key == "l1VolumeHoldup" || field.Key == "l2VolumeHoldup")
					{
						field.Visibility = ((!(flag3 && flag4) || !num.HasValue) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
					}
					else if (field.Key.Contains("Pot_"))
					{
						field.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetVarListIndexAndCount()
		{
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = null;
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val != null)

				if (elementChildren != null)
				{
					enumerable = elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
				}
			}
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<int> enumerable2 = enumerable.Select((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
			if (enumerable2 == null || enumerable2.Count() == 0)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				VarListStartIndex = enumerable2.Min();
				VarListCount = enumerable2.Count();
			}
		}

		private void SetStageIndexAndCount()
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.NSTAGE", "value"));
			if (!num.HasValue || num < 2)
			{
				StageItemLowerLimit = 0;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 0;
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Properties_Locations_Stage);
				return;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.CONDENSER", "value"));
			HasSecondCondenser = text == "PARTIAL2";
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.REFLUXDRUM", "value"));
			HasDrum = text2 == "YES";
			int num2 = 2;
			if (num.Value - 1 < num2)
			{
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Properties_Locations_Stage);
				StageItemLowerLimit = 1;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 1;
				return;
			}
			if (!oCollection.Contains(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Properties_Locations_Stage))
			{
				oCollection.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_Properties_Locations_Stage);
			}
			StageItemLowerLimit = 2;
			StageItemUpperLimit = num.Value - 1;
		}

			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_Properties.grdTimeProfilesProperties.InvalidateGridData();
			}
		}

			if (num.Value - 1 < num2)
			{
				oCollection.Remove(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_TPFQ_Locations_Stage);
				StageItemLowerLimit = 1;
				StageItemUpperLimit = 1;
				return;
			}
			if (!oCollection.Contains(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_TPFQ_Locations_Stage))
			{
				oCollection.Add(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_TPFQ_Locations_Stage);
			}
			StageItemLowerLimit = 2;
			StageItemUpperLimit = num.Value - 1;
		}

		private void SetVarListIndexAndCount()
		{
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = null;
			AccessorElement val = ViewDataContainerExtensions.AdbGetElement((ICxvViewDataContainer)(object)this, "@main.SharedData.VarListTimeProfile.profileList", ((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider);
			if (val != null)
			{
				IEnumerable<AccessorElement> elementChildren = AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(((MMViewModel)this).AdbTopProvider, val);
				if (elementChildren != null)
				{
					enumerable = elementChildren.Select((AccessorElement p) => AdbExtensions.GetName(p)).ToArray();
				}
			}
			if (enumerable == null || enumerable.Count() == 0)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<int> enumerable2 = enumerable.Select((string x) => Convert.ToInt32(x));
			if (enumerable2 == null || enumerable2.Count() == 0)
			{
				VarListStartIndex = 0;
				VarListCount = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				VarListStartIndex = enumerable2.Min();
				VarListCount = enumerable2.Count();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVarParameters()
		{
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_Temperature", (object)$"T({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_Pressure", (object)$"P({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_HeatDuty", (object)$"QNET({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_LiquidMassFlow", (object)$"FMLOUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_LiquidMoleFlow", (object)$"FLOUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_liquid1MoleFlow", (object)$"FL1OUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_liquid1MassFlow", (object)$"FML1OUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_liquid2MoleFlow", (object)$"FL2OUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_liquid2MassFlow", (object)$"FML2OUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_VaporMoleFlow", (object)$"FVOUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("p_VaporMassFlow", (object)$"FMVOUT({SelectedStageID})", true);
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_TPFQ { grdTimeProfilesTPFQ: not null } mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_TPFQ)
			{
				mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_TPFQ.grdTimeProfilesTPFQ.InvalidateGridData();
			}
		}

		private void SetGridColumnsVisibility()
		{
			if (!(((MMViewModel)this).View is MMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_TPFQ { grdTimeProfilesTPFQ: not null } mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_TPFQ))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("Basis_Selected.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null)) == ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_TimeProfiles_TPFQ_Basis_Mass;
			bool flag2 = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveViewPropertyPath("NotOneLiquid.Value", (CxvPropertyWatch)null)) ?? false;
			bool flag3 = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.CC Nodes.CONFG8", "value")) ?? false;
			foreach (AdsField field in mMBatchSep_AdsTimeProfiles_TPFQ.grdTimeProfilesTPFQ.Fields)
			{
				if (field.Key == "vaporMoleFlow")
				{
					field.Visibility = (flag ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else if (field.Key == "liquidMoleFlow")
				{
					field.Visibility = ((!(!flag && flag3)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else if (field.Key == "vaporMassFlow")
				{
					field.Visibility = ((!flag) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else if (field.Key == "liquidMassFlow")
				{
					field.Visibility = ((!(flag && flag3)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else if (field.Key == "liquid1MoleFlow" || field.Key == "liquid2MoleFlow")
				{
					field.Visibility = ((!(!flag && flag2 && flag3)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
				else if (field.Key == "liquid1MassFlow" || field.Key == "liquid2MassFlow")
				{
					field.Visibility = ((!(flag && flag2 && flag3)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			public string Description { get; set; }

			public string Value { get; set; }

			public string UOM { get; set; }
		}

		public LoadVesselDialog(MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel model)
		{
