			_model = model;
		}

		public void LoadAspenBatchModelerVesselLibrary()
		{
			string filename = Registry.GetValue("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\AspenTech\\AMSystem\\41.0\\Dir", "Bin", "").ToString() + "VesselLibrary.vsll";
			LoadXML(filename, ref ModelerVesselProperties);
		}

		public void LoadXML(string filename, ref Dictionary<string, VesselDetails> propertiesMap)
		{
			ManufacturerListSource = new List<string>();
			propertiesMap = new Dictionary<string, VesselDetails>();
			string text = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				using XmlReader xmlReader = XmlReader.Create(filename);
				while (xmlReader.Read())
				{
					if (xmlReader.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || !(xmlReader.Name == "Vessel"))
					{
						continue;
					}
					VesselDetails vesselDetails = new VesselDetails();
					vesselDetails.PropertyTable = new List<Property>();
					vesselDetails.ID = xmlReader.GetAttribute("VesselID");
					VesselDetails value = new VesselDetails();
					if (propertiesMap.TryGetValue(vesselDetails.ID, out value))
					{
						System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message1);
						propertiesMap.Clear();
						return;
					}
					XmlReader xmlReader2 = xmlReader.ReadSubtree();
					while (xmlReader2.Read())
					{
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && xmlReader2.Name == "Description")
						{
							string description = xmlReader2.ReadElementContentAsString();
							text = vesselDetails.ID;
							vesselDetails.Description = description;
						}
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && xmlReader2.Name == "Manufacturer")
						{
							vesselDetails.Manufacturer = xmlReader2.ReadElementContentAsString();
							if (!ManufacturerListSource.Contains(vesselDetails.Manufacturer))
							{
								ManufacturerListSource.Add(vesselDetails.Manufacturer);
							}
						}
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType == XmlNodeType.Element && xmlReader2.Name == "Model")
						{
							vesselDetails.Model = xmlReader2.ReadElementContentAsString();
						}
						if (xmlReader2.NodeType != XmlNodeType.Element || !(xmlReader2.Name == "PropertyTable"))
						{
							continue;
						}
						XmlReader xmlReader3 = xmlReader2.ReadSubtree();
						while (xmlReader3.ReadToFollowing("Property"))
						{
							Property property = new Property();
							XmlReader xmlReader4 = xmlReader3.ReadSubtree();
							while (xmlReader4.Read())
							{
								switch (xmlReader4.Name)
								{
								case "Description":
									property.Description = xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsString();
									property.LocalizedDescription = LocalizeDescription(property.Description);
									break;
								case "Value":
									property.Value = xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsString();
									break;
								case "UOM":
									property.UOM = xmlReader3.ReadElementContentAsString();
									break;
								}
							}
							if (property.Description == "Jacket covers bottom" || property.Description == "Jacket covers bottom head")
							{
								if (property.Value == "1")
								{
									property.Value = "Yes";
								}
								else if (property.Value == "0")
								{
									property.Value = "No";
								}
							}
							vesselDetails.PropertyTable.Add(property);
						}
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						text = vesselDetails.ID;
					}
					propertiesMap.Add(text, vesselDetails);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message2);
			}
			ManufacturerListSource.Sort();
		}

		private string LocalizeDescription(string Description)
		{
			string result = Description;
			switch (Description.ToUpper())
			{
			case "CAPACITY":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_Capacity;
				break;
			case "FOULING COEFFICIENT":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_FoulingCoefficient;
				break;
			case "LINING CONDUCTIVITY":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_LiningConductivity;
				break;
			case "LINING THICKNESS":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_LiningThickness;
				break;
			case "MINIMUM STIRRED VOLUME":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_MinimumStirredVolume;
				break;
			case "STRAIGHT SIDE":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_StraightSide;
				break;
			case "SURFACE AREA":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_SurfaceArea;
				break;
			case "INTERNAL DIAMETER":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_InternalDiameter;
				break;
			case "VESSEL MASS":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_VesselMass;
				break;
			case "WALL CONDUCTIVITY":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_WallConductivity;
				break;
			case "WALL THICKNESS":
				result = ApwnResources.Vessel_Description_WallThickness;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ComboBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ManufacturerList.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				List<string> list = (from pair in ModelerVesselProperties
					where pair.Value.Manufacturer == ManufacturerList.SelectedItem.ToString()
					select pair.Value.Description).ToList();
				list.Sort();
				VesselList.ItemsSource = list;
			}
			else
			{
				VesselList.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		private void VesselList_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (VesselList.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				List<VesselDetails> list = (from pair in ModelerVesselProperties
					where pair.Value.Description == VesselList.SelectedItem.ToString()
					select pair.Value).ToList();
				if (list != null && list.Count > 0)
				{
					currentSelection = list[0];
					VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = currentSelection.PropertyTable;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		private void OKbutton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (rbModelerLibrary.IsChecked == true && ManufacturerList.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message3);
				return;
			}
			if (rbModelerLibrary.IsChecked == true && VesselList.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message4);
				return;
			}
			if (rbUserLibrary.IsChecked == true && string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselLibraryText.Text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message5);
				return;
			}
			if (rbUserLibrary.IsChecked == true && VesselID.SelectedItem == null)
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(WpfMMDialogResources.LoadVesselDialog_Message6);
				return;
			}
			if (rbUserLibrary.IsChecked == true && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselLibraryText.Text))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value", (object)VesselLibraryText.Text);
			}
			((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELID", "value", (object)currentSelection.ID);
			((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VDESCRIPTION", "value", (object)currentSelection.Description);
			foreach (Property item in currentSelection.PropertyTable)
			{
				double result = 0.0;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				switch (item.Description.ToUpper())
				{
				case "VESSEL MASS":
				case "MASS":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POT_MASS", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "GEOMETRY SPECIFICATION":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "TOP HEAD TYPE":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.TOPHEAD", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "ORIENTATION":
				case "POT ORIENTATION":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.ORIENTATION", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "BOTTOM HEAD TYPE":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.BOTTOMHEAD", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "WALL CONDUCTIVITY":
				case "WALL THERMAL CONDUCTIVITY":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetWallConductivityUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTWALLK", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "DISH RADIUS RATIO":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FD", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "CONE HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF CONICAL HEAD":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.CONEHEIGHT", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "KNUCKLE RADIUS RATIO":
				case "RATIO OF   KNUCKLE RADIUS TO VESSEL DIAMETER":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.KD", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "WALL THICKNESS":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.POTWALLTHICK", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "INTERNAL DIAMETER":
				case "DIAMETER":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.D", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "CAPACITY":
				case "VOLUME":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetCapacityUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.V", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "STRAIGHT SIDE":
				case "TANGENT-TO-TANGENT LENGTH":
				case "TAN-TAN LENGTH":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.L", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "JACKET COVERS BOTTOM HEAD":
				case "JACKET COVERS BOTTOM":
				{
					int checkboxSetting = GetCheckboxSetting(item.Value);
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.JA_COVERSHD", "value", (object)checkboxSetting);
					break;
				}
				case "JACKET BOTTOM HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF JACKET BOTTOM FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.LLOWJACKET", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "JACKET TOP HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF JACKET TOP FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.LHIGHJACKET", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "COILS HEAT TRANSFER AREA":
				case "COIL HEAT TRANSFER AREA":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetAreaUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.ACOILS", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "COIL TOP HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF COIL TOP FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.LHIGHCOILS", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "COIL BOTTOM HEIGHT":
				case "HEIGHT OF COIL BOTTOM FROM VESSEL BOTTOM":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetLengthUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.LLOWCOILS", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "EXCHANGER HEAT TRANSFER AREA":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						empty = SetAreaUnits(item.UOM);
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.AEXTHX", "value", empty, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "RECIRCULATION RATE":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.FMEXTHX", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				case "AGITATOR":
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.AGIT_TYPE", "value", (object)item.Value.ToUpper());
					break;
				case "AGITATOR DIAMETER":
					if (double.TryParse(item.Value, out result))
					{
						((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.AGIT_DIA", "value", item.UOM, (object)result);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			Close();
		}

		private string SetLengthUnits(string uom)
		{
			string result = uom;
			if (uom == "m")
			{
				result = "meter";
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int GetCheckboxSetting(string value)
		{
			int result = 1;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				if (value.ToUpper() == "TRUE" || value.ToUpper() == "YES")
				{
					result = 1;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!(value.ToUpper() == "FALSE") && !(value.ToUpper() == "NO"))
					{
						int.TryParse(value, out result);
						return result;
					}
					result = 0;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string SetWallConductivityUnits(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				switch (value.ToUpper())
				{
				case "BTU IN/H/FT2/R":
					result = "Btu-in/hr-sqft-R";
					break;
				case "BTU/H/FT/F":
					result = "Btu/hr-ft-F";
					break;
				case "CAL CM/S/CM2/K":
					result = "cal-cm/sec-sqcm-K";
					break;
				case "KCAL/H/M/K":
					result = "kcal/hr-m-K";
					break;
				case "KW/M/K":
					result = "kW/m-K";
					break;
				case "W/M/K":
					result = "Watt/m-K";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string SetCapacityUnits(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				switch (value.ToUpper())
				{
				case "FT3":
					result = "cuft";
					break;
				case "IN3":
					result = "cuin";
					break;
				case "M3":
					result = "cum";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private string SetAreaUnits(string value)
		{
			string result = value;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				switch (value.ToUpper())
				{
				case "CM2":
					result = "sqcm";
					break;
				case "FT2":
					result = "sqft";
					break;
				case "IN2":
					result = "sqin";
					break;
				case "M2":
					result = "sqm";
					break;
				case "MILE2":
					result = "sqmile";
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void CancelButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			Close();
		}

		private void rbModelerLibrary_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModelerOptions != null)
			{
				ModelerOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (UserOptions != null)
			{
				UserOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (VesselDescriptionText != null)
			{
				VesselDescriptionText.Text = null;
			}
			if (VesselPropTable != null)
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		private void rbUserLibrary_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModelerOptions != null)
			{
				ModelerOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			if (UserOptions != null)
			{
				UserOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			if (ManufacturerList != null)
			{
				ManufacturerList.SelectedItem = null;
			}
			if (VesselList != null)
			{
				VesselList.SelectedItem = null;
			}
			if (VesselPropTable != null)
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && File.Exists(text))
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = text;
				if (File.Exists(VesselLibraryText.Text))
				{
					LoadXML(VesselLibraryText.Text, ref UserVesselProperties);
					List<string> list = UserVesselProperties.Values.Select((VesselDetails c) => c.ID).ToList();
					list.Sort();
					VesselID.ItemsSource = list;
					VesselDescriptionText.Text = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = null;
				if (VesselID != null)
				{
					VesselID.ItemsSource = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void BrowseBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new System.Windows.Forms.OpenFileDialog();
			openFileDialog.Filter = "Vessel Library Files (*.vsll)|*.vsll";
			openFileDialog.Title = "Open vessel library";
			openFileDialog.CheckPathExists = true;
			openFileDialog.RestoreDirectory = true;
			if (openFileDialog.ShowDialog() == System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.OK)
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
				LoadXML(openFileDialog.FileName, ref UserVesselProperties);
				List<string> list = UserVesselProperties.Values.Select((VesselDetails c) => c.ID).ToList();
				list.Sort();
				VesselID.ItemsSource = list;
				VesselDescriptionText.Text = null;
			}
		}

		private void VesselID_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (VesselID.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				VesselDetails value = new VesselDetails();
				if (UserVesselProperties.TryGetValue(VesselID.SelectedItem.ToString(), out value))
				{
					currentSelection = value;
					VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = currentSelection.PropertyTable;
					VesselDescriptionText.Text = currentSelection.Description;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = null;
			}
		}

		public SaveVesselDialog(MMBatchSep_Setup_PotGeometry_ViewModel model)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			_model = model;
			_vesselLibrary = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_vesselLibrary) && File.Exists(_vesselLibrary))
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = _vesselLibrary;
			}
			else
			{
				VesselLibraryText.Text = Directory.GetCurrentDirectory() + "\\UserVesselLibrary.vsll";
			}
			_vesselID = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VESSELID", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_vesselID))
			{
				VesselIDText.Text = _vesselID;
			}
			_vesselDescription = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.VDESCRIPTION", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_vesselDescription))
			{
				VesselDescriptionText.Text = _vesselDescription;
			}
			vesselDetails = new List<Property>();
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_MassItem, "@main.Input.POT_MASS", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_WallThickness, "@main.Input.POTWALLTHICK", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_WallThermalConductivity, "@main.Input.POTWALLK", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_GeometrySpecification, "@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", ref vesselDetails);
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.GEOMETRYSPEC", "value"));
			if (text != "LV")
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_Diameter, "@main.Input.D", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			if (text != "DL")
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_VolumeItem, "@main.Input.V", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			if (text != "DV")
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_TanTanLength, "@main.Input.L", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_PotOrientation, "@main.Input.ORIENTATION", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_TopHeadType, "@main.Input.TOPHEAD", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_BottomHeadType, "@main.Input.BOTTOMHEAD", ref vesselDetails);
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.TOPHEAD", "value"));
			string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.BOTTOMHEAD", "value"));
			if ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2 == "TORISPHERICAL") || (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3 == "TORISPHERICAL"))
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_DishRadiusRatio, "@main.Input.FD", ref vesselDetails);
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_KnuckleRadiusRatio, "@main.Input.KD", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			if ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && text2 == "CONICAL") || (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3) && text3 == "CONICAL"))
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_ConeHeight, "@main.Input.CONEHEIGHT", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_JacketCoversBottom, "@main.Input.JA_COVERSHD", ref vesselDetails, ConvertCheckbox: true);
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.JA_COVERSHD", "value"));
			if (num.HasValue && num == 0)
			{
				AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_JacketBottomHeight, "@main.Input.LLOWJACKET", ref vesselDetails);
			}
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_JacketTopHeight, "@main.Input.LHIGHJACKET", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_CoilsHeatTransferArea, "@main.Input.ACOILS", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_CoilTopHeight, "@main.Input.LHIGHCOILS", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_CoilBottomHeight, "@main.Input.LLOWCOILS", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_ExchangerHeat, "@main.Input.AEXTHX", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_RecirculationRate, "@main.Input.FMEXTHX", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_Agitator, "@main.Input.AGIT_TYPE", ref vesselDetails);
			AddToDetails(ApwnResources.MMBatchSep_Setup_Pot_SaveVesselDialog_AgitatorDiameter, "@main.Input.AGIT_DIA", ref vesselDetails);
			VesselPropTable.ItemsSource = vesselDetails;
		}

		private void AddToDetails(string Description, string DataPath, ref List<Property> details, bool ConvertCheckbox = false)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(DataPath, "value"));
			string uOM = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(DataPath, "uom"));
			bool? flag = CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndGet(DataPath, "user_entered"));
			Property property = new Property();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && flag.HasValue && flag == true)
			{
				property.Description = Description;
				if (!ConvertCheckbox)
				{
					property.Value = text;
				}
				else if (text == "0")
				{
					property.Value = "No";
				}
				else if (text == "1")
				{
					property.Value = "Yes";
				}
				property.UOM = uOM;
				details.Add(property);
			}
		}

		private void OKbutton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselIDText.Text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("Vessel ID must be specified.");
				return;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(VesselLibraryText.Text))
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("Vessel library must be specified.");
				return;
			}
			if (System.IO.Path.GetExtension(VesselLibraryText.Text).ToLower() != ".vsll")
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("Please enter a valid library name.  A valid library name has the extension \".vsll\".");
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (VesselIDText.Text != _vesselID)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELID", "value", (object)VesselIDText.Text);
				}
				if (VesselDescriptionText.Text != _vesselDescription)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VDESCRIPTION", "value", (object)VesselDescriptionText.Text);
				}
				if (VesselLibraryText.Text != _vesselLibrary)
				{
					((CxvViewModel)_model).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.VESSELLIB", "value", (object)VesselLibraryText.Text);
				}
				if (!File.Exists(VesselLibraryText.Text))
				{
					XmlWriterSettings xmlWriterSettings = new XmlWriterSettings();
					xmlWriterSettings.Indent = true;
					using XmlWriter xmlWriter = XmlWriter.Create(VesselLibraryText.Text, xmlWriterSettings);
					xmlWriter.WriteStartDocument();
					xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("VesselTable");
					xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("Vessel");
					xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("VesselID", VesselIDText.Text);
					xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Description", VesselDescriptionText.Text);
					xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("PropertyTable");
					foreach (Property vesselDetail in vesselDetails)
					{
						xmlWriter.WriteStartElement("Property");
						xmlWriter.WriteAttributeString("Name", vesselDetail.Description.Replace(" ", ""));
						xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Description", vesselDetail.Description);
						xmlWriter.WriteElementString("Value", vesselDetail.Value);
						xmlWriter.WriteElementString("UOM", vesselDetail.UOM);
						xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					}
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					xmlWriter.WriteEndElement();
					xmlWriter.WriteEndDocument();
					xmlWriter.Close();
				}
				else
				{
					XDocument xDocument = XDocument.Load(VesselLibraryText.Text);
					XElement xElement = xDocument.Element("VesselTable");
					XElement xElement2 = (from vessel in xElement.Elements("Vessel")
						where vessel.Attribute("VesselID").Value == VesselIDText.Text
						select vessel).FirstOrDefault();
					if (xElement2 != null)
					{
						if (System.Windows.MessageBox.Show("Replace existing vessel with ID \"" + VesselIDText.Text + "\"?", "Replace Confirmation", MessageBoxButton.YesNo) != MessageBoxResult.Yes)
						{
							return;
						}
						xElement2.Remove();
					}
					xElement.Add(new XElement("Vessel", new XAttribute("VesselID", VesselIDText.Text), new XElement("Description", VesselDescriptionText.Text), new XElement("PropertyTable")));
					if (vesselDetails != null && vesselDetails.Count > 0)
					{
						XElement xElement3 = (from vessel in xElement.Elements("Vessel")
							where vessel.Attribute("VesselID").Value == VesselIDText.Text
							select vessel).FirstOrDefault();
						if (xElement3 != null)
						{
							XElement xElement4 = xElement3.Elements("PropertyTable").FirstOrDefault();
							foreach (Property vesselDetail2 in vesselDetails)
							{
								xElement4.Add(new XElement("Property", new XAttribute("Name", vesselDetail2.Description.Replace(" ", "")), new XElement("Description", vesselDetail2.Description), new XElement("Value", vesselDetail2.Value), new XElement("UOM", vesselDetail2.UOM)));
							}
						}
					}
					xDocument.Save(VesselLibraryText.Text);
				}
				Close();
			}
			catch
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show("The vessel library could not be read.");
			}
		}

		public void ClearResults()
		{
			Duration = null;
			RunningStatus = UnitProcedureRunningStatus.Off;
			StartTime = null;
			EndTime = null;
			foreach (OperationStepData step in Steps)
			{
				step.Duration = null;
				step.StartTime = null;
				step.EndTime = null;
				step.StopCriterion.Reset();
			}
		}

		public void CopyResults(AdsUnitProcedureResultData adsProcedureData)
		{
			if (adsProcedureData == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("adsProcedureData");
			}
			RunningStatus = adsProcedureData.Status;
			foreach (OperationStepData step in Steps)
			{
				step.StartTime = adsProcedureData.GetStartTime(step.Name);
				step.EndTime = adsProcedureData.GetDoneTime(step.Name);
				if (step.StartTime.HasValue && step.EndTime.HasValue)
				{
					step.Duration = step.EndTime.Value - step.StartTime.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					step.Duration = null;
				}
				step.DoneInfo = adsProcedureData.GetStepDoneInfo(step.Name);
			}
			StartTime = Steps.FirstOrDefault()?.StartTime;
			EndTime = Steps.LastOrDefault()?.EndTime;
			Duration = adsProcedureData.GetDuration();
		}
	}

		public StopCriterionData StopCriterion => _stopCriterion ?? (_stopCriterion = new StopCriterionData());

		public void UpdateStopCriterion(SummaryResultsDataProvider dataProvider, TimeUnitHelper unitHelper, string procedureId)
		{
			if (dataProvider == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataProvider");
			}
			if (unitHelper == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unitHelper");
			}
			StopCriterionData stopCriterion = StopCriterion;
			stopCriterion.Reset();
			if (!EndTime.HasValue || DoneInfo == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(DoneInfo.VariableId))
			{
				return;
			}
			stopCriterion.Variable = DoneInfo.VariableId;
			stopCriterion.Description = DoneInfo.VariableUIDescription;
			if (DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.HasValue)
			{
				if (DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.Value == 24)
				{
					stopCriterion.TriggerValueUnit = unitHelper.ResultTimeUnit.DisplayedUnit;
				}
				else
				{
					stopCriterion.TriggerValueUnit = unitHelper.UnitsProvider.GetDefaultDisplayUnits((object)DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.Value);
				}
			}
			if (DoneInfo.VariableValue.HasValue)
			{
				if (DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.HasValue && DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.Value != 0)
				{
					if (DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.Value == 24)
					{
						stopCriterion.TriggerValue = unitHelper.ResultTimeUnit.FactorOnSI * DoneInfo.VariableValue.Value;
					}
					else
					{
						stopCriterion.TriggerValue = unitHelper.UnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)DoneInfo.VariableUnitRow.Value, DoneInfo.VariableValue.Value, stopCriterion.TriggerValueUnit);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stopCriterion.TriggerValue = DoneInfo.VariableValue;
				}
			}
			stopCriterion.ApproachFrom = DoneInfo.Approach;
		}
	}

	public class AdsUnitProcedureResultData
	{
		public string ProcedureId { get; set; }

		public UnitProcedureRunningStatus Status { get; set; }

		public string RunningStep { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan? CurrentTime { get; set; }

		public TimeSpan? DoneTime { get; set; }

		public IDictionary<string, AdsStepStartedInfo> StartedInfos { get; private set; }

		public IDictionary<string, AdsStepDoneInfo> DoneInfos { get; private set; }

		public AdsUnitProcedureResultData()
		{
			StartedInfos = new Dictionary<string, AdsStepStartedInfo>();
			DoneInfos = new Dictionary<string, AdsStepDoneInfo>();
		}

		public TimeSpan? GetStartTime(string operationStepId)
		{
			if (StartedInfos.ContainsKey(operationStepId))
			{
				return StartedInfos[operationStepId].StartedTime;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public TimeSpan? GetDoneTime(string operationStepId)
		{
			if (DoneInfos.ContainsKey(operationStepId))
			{
				return DoneInfos[operationStepId].Time;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public TimeSpan? GetDuration()
		{
			if (StartedInfos.Count > 0)
			{
				if (DoneTime.HasValue)
				{
					return DoneTime.Value - StartedInfos.First().Value.StartedTime;
				}
				if (DoneInfos.Count > 0)
				{
					return DoneInfos.Last().Value.Time - StartedInfos.First().Value.StartedTime;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public AdsStepDoneInfo GetStepDoneInfo(string operationStepId)
		{
			if (DoneInfos.ContainsKey(operationStepId))
			{
				return DoneInfos[operationStepId];
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SummaryResultsDataProvider

		private const string AdsRootFlowsheetPath = "Flowsheet";

		private const string SegmentBlocks = ".Blocks.";

		private const string AdsSegmentSubFlowsheetsSimulation = ".SubFlowsheets.Simulation";

		private const string CxsTopAppModelV8 = "Top.AppModelV8";

		private const string CxsUnitProceduresNode = "Unit Procedures";

		private readonly IUnityContainer _unityContainer;

		private readonly string _flowsheetPath;

		private IAdbTopProvider _adbTopProvider;

		private CxsCase _activeCase;

		private string _cxsUnitProceduresPath;

		private string _adsFlowhseetPath;

		private CxsCase ActiveCase
		{
			get
			{
				if (_activeCase == null)
				{
					IShellApplication obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IShellApplication>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
					IApwnApplication val = (IApwnApplication)(object)((obj is IApwnApplication) ? obj : null);
					if (val != null && val.ActiveDocument != null)
					{
						_activeCase = val.ActiveDocument.Case;
					}
				}
				return _activeCase;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (_adbTopProvider == null)
				{
					_adbTopProvider = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IAdbTopProvider>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
				}
				return _adbTopProvider;
			}
		}

		private string AdsFlowsheetPath
		{
			get
			{
				if (_adsFlowhseetPath == null)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_flowsheetPath))
					{
						_adsFlowhseetPath = "Flowsheet";
					}
					else if (IsBatchFlowsheet("Flowsheet"))
					{
						_adsFlowhseetPath = "Flowsheet";
					}
					else
					{
						string[] array = _flowsheetPath.Split('.');
						StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("Flowsheet");
						string[] array2 = array;
						foreach (string value in array2)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(".Blocks.").Append(value).Append(".SubFlowsheets.Simulation");
							if (IsBatchFlowsheet(stringBuilder.ToString()))
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						_adsFlowhseetPath = stringBuilder.ToString();
					}
				}
				return _adsFlowhseetPath;
			}
		}

		private string CxsUnitProceduresPath
		{
			get
			{
				if (_cxsUnitProceduresPath == null)
				{
					if (string.Equals(AdsFlowsheetPath, "Flowsheet", StringComparison.InvariantCulture))
					{
						_cxsUnitProceduresPath = "Top.AppModelV8.Unit Procedures";
					}
					else
					{
						string adsFlowsheetPath = AdsFlowsheetPath;
						adsFlowsheetPath = "Top.AppModelV8.Blocks." + adsFlowsheetPath.Substring("Flowsheet".Length + ".Blocks.".Length);
						adsFlowsheetPath = adsFlowsheetPath.Replace(".SubFlowsheets.Simulation.", ".Data.");
						adsFlowsheetPath = adsFlowsheetPath.Substring(0, adsFlowsheetPath.LastIndexOf(".SubFlowsheets.Simulation"));
						_cxsUnitProceduresPath = adsFlowsheetPath + ".Data.Unit Procedures";
					}
				}
				return _cxsUnitProceduresPath;
			}
		}

					Func<string, string> pathFunc = (string x) => $"{CxsUnitProceduresPath}.{x}.Input.ACTIVE";
					string[] array2 = GetCxsResults(array, pathFunc, "value").ToArray();
					for (int num = 0; num < array.Length && num < array2.Length; num++)

					AdsUnitProcedureResultData adsUnitProcedureResultData = CreateAdsUnitProcedureData(stringValue, stringValue2, stringValue3, doubleValue, doubleValue2);
					foreach (AccessorElement elementChild2 in AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(AdbTopProvider, AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild, "stepStartedTime")))
					{
						double? doubleValue3 = AdbExtensions.GetDoubleValue(elementChild2);
						if (doubleValue3.HasValue)

							adsUnitProcedureResultData.StartedInfos[AdbExtensions.GetName(elementChild2)] = new AdsStepStartedInfo(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(doubleValue3.Value));
						}
					}
					foreach (AccessorElement elementChild3 in AdbExtensions.GetElementChildren(AdbTopProvider, AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild, "stepDoneInfos")))
					{
						double? doubleValue4 = AdbExtensions.GetDoubleValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "doneTime"));
						string stringValue4 = AdbExtensions.GetStringValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "doneVarID"));
						string stringValue5 = AdbExtensions.GetStringValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "doneVarDescription"));
						double? variableValue = CxsConverter.ValueToDouble(smallValueToZeroConverter.Convert(AdbExtensions.GetDoubleValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "doneVarVal")), null, null, null));
						int? integerValue = AdbExtensions.GetIntegerValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "donePType"));
						string stringValue6 = AdbExtensions.GetStringValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "doneCause"));
						string stringValue7 = AdbExtensions.GetStringValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, elementChild3, "doneApproach"));
						string cxsStepPath = CxsUnitProceduresPath + "." + stringValue + ".Subobjects.Operations." + elementChild3.attribute;
						string variableDescription = new VariableDescriptionHelper(ActiveCase, cxsStepPath).GetVariableDescription(stringValue4);
						if (doubleValue4.HasValue)
						{
							adsUnitProcedureResultData.DoneInfos[AdbExtensions.GetName(elementChild3)] = new AdsStepDoneInfo(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(doubleValue4.Value), stringValue4, stringValue5, variableDescription, variableValue, integerValue, stringValue6, stringValue7);
						}
					}
					list.Add(adsUnitProcedureResultData);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool IsBatchFlowsheet(string adsFlowsheetPath)
		{
			if (AdbTopProvider != null)
			{
				return AdbExtensions.GetBooleanValue(AdbExtensions.GetAccessorElement(AdbTopProvider, adsFlowsheetPath + ".IsBatch")) == true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetCxsResults(IEnumerable<string> ids, Func<string, string> pathFunc, string attribute)
		{
			List<CxsBatchRequest> list = new List<CxsBatchRequest>();
			CxsBatchRequest item = default(CxsBatchRequest);
			foreach (string id in ids)
			{
				((CxsBatchRequest)(ref item))..ctor(pathFunc(id), attribute);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			object[] array = ActiveCase.BatchGet(list.ToArray());
			if (array != null)
			{
				object[] array2 = array;
				foreach (object obj in array2)
				{
					yield return CxsConverter.ValueToString(obj);
				}
			}
		}

		private AdsUnitProcedureResultData CreateAdsUnitProcedureData(string id, string stat, string runningStep, double? currentTime, double? doneTime)
		{
			AdsUnitProcedureResultData adsUnitProcedureResultData = new AdsUnitProcedureResultData
			{
				ProcedureId = id,
				RunningStep = runningStep
			};
			if (string.Equals(stat, "ON", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				adsUnitProcedureResultData.Status = UnitProcedureRunningStatus.On;
			}
			else if (string.Equals(stat, "DONE", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				adsUnitProcedureResultData.Status = UnitProcedureRunningStatus.Done;
			}
			else
			{
				adsUnitProcedureResultData.Status = UnitProcedureRunningStatus.Off;
			}
			if (currentTime.HasValue)
			{
				adsUnitProcedureResultData.CurrentTime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(currentTime.Value);
			}
			if (doneTime.HasValue)
			{
				adsUnitProcedureResultData.DoneTime = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(doneTime.Value);
			}
			return adsUnitProcedureResultData;
		}
	}

		public string GetVariableDescription(string variableName)
		{
			string result = null;
			string text = null;
			string text2 = _cxsStepPath + ".Input.";
			string text3 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text2 + "FVN_VARTYPE." + variableName, "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
			{
				return result;
			}
			string text4 = null;
			if (_streamVarList.Contains(text3))
			{
				text4 = text3;
			}
			foreach (string varible in _varibleList)
			{
				string text5 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text2 + varible + "." + variableName, "value"));
				string text6 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(_cxsCase.BatchGet(text2 + varible + "." + variableName, "can_enter"));
				if (text6 == null)
				{
					text6 = "0";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text5) && text6 == "1")
				{
					string text7 = string.Empty;
					if (text5 == "CONTROL-MODE")
					{
						text7 = " (0 - " + Resources.PID_Automatic + ", 1 - " + Resources.PID_Manual + ")";
					}
					if (text5 == "FILTER")
					{
						text7 = " (0 - " + Resources.BatchOp_DisableFiltration + ", 1 - " + Resources.BatchOp_EnableFiltration + ")";
					}
					text5 += text7;
					text = text + text5 + ".";
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text4))
					{
						text = text + text4 + ".";
						text4 = "";
					}
				}
			}
			if (text.EndsWith("."))
			{
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
			}
			return text;
		}

			bool[] array2 = new bool[oplist.Count];

			{
				array[i] = oplist[i];
				array2[i] = false;
			}
			foreach (VarType varType in _varTypes)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (array[j] == varType.UCase)
					{
						list.Add(varType);
						array2[j] = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
			{
				if (!array2[k])
				{
					list.Add(new VarType
					{
						UCase = array[k],
						MCase = StrConvMixCase(array[k])
					});
				}
			}
			_varTypes = list;
		}

		private string StrConvMixCase(string InpVal)
		{
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				int result = 0;
				if (int.TryParse(InpVal, out result))
				{
					text = InpVal;
					return text;
				}
				string[] array = InpVal.Split('-');
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (array[i].Length > 1)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].Substring(0, 1).ToUpper() + array[i].Substring(1).ToLower();
					}
					else if (array[i].Length > 0)
					{
						array[i] = array[i].ToUpper();
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length - 1; j++)
				{
					text = text + array[j] + "-";
				}
				text += array[array.Length - 1];
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return text;
		}

	public class SummaryResultsGraphView : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private class GanttViewItemTimeRangeConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (values != null && values.Length == 3)
				{
					TimeSpan? timeSpan = values[0] as TimeSpan?;
					TimeSpan? timeSpan2 = values[1] as TimeSpan?;
					TimeSpan? timeSpan3 = values[2] as TimeSpan?;
					if (timeSpan.HasValue)
					{
						if (timeSpan2.HasValue)
						{
							return new TimeRange(timeSpan.Value, timeSpan2.Value - timeSpan.Value);
						}
						if (timeSpan3.HasValue)
						{
							return new TimeRange(timeSpan.Value, timeSpan3.Value - timeSpan.Value);
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TotalTimeSpanProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TotalTimeSpan", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(SummaryResultsGraphView));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewportRangeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ViewportRange", typeof(TimeRange), typeof(SummaryResultsGraphView));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CalendarColumnWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CalendarColumnWidth", typeof(TimeSpan), typeof(SummaryResultsGraphView));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CurrentTimeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CurrentTime", typeof(TimeSpan?), typeof(SummaryResultsGraphView));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty TimeUnitProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TimeUnit", typeof(TimeUnitInfo), typeof(SummaryResultsGraphView));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ZoomScaleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ZoomScale", typeof(double), typeof(SummaryResultsGraphView), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(1.0, OnZoomScalePropertyChanged));

		private DispatcherOperation _rebuildRowsOperation;

		internal GanttView gv;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public TimeSpan TotalTimeSpan
		{

				return (TimeSpan)GetValue(TotalTimeSpanProperty);

		}

		public ObservableCollection<ProcedureData> Procedures { get; private set; }

		public SummaryResultsGraphView()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			DoInitialize();
		}

		private void DoInitialize()
		{
			gv.SetBinding(GanttView.TotalTimeSpanProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(TotalTimeSpanProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			gv.SetBinding(GanttView.DisplayedTimeRangeProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ViewportRangeProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			gv.SetBinding(GanttView.CalendarUnitLengthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(CalendarColumnWidthProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			gv.SetBinding(GanttView.CurrentTimeProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(CurrentTimeProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			gv.SetBinding(GanttView.TimeUnitProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(TimeUnitProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			InitializeProcedures(new ObservableCollection<ProcedureData>());
		}

		public void InitializeProcedures(ObservableCollection<ProcedureData> procedures)
		{
			if (procedures == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("procedures");
			}
			if (Procedures != null)
			{
				Procedures.CollectionChanged -= Procedures_CollectionChanged;
			}
			Procedures = procedures;
			Procedures.CollectionChanged += Procedures_CollectionChanged;
		}

		protected virtual void OnZomScaleChanged(double oldValue, double newValue)
		{
			if (newValue <= 0.0 || newValue == 1.0)
			{
				gv.LayoutTransform = Transform.Identity;
			}
			else
			{
				gv.LayoutTransform = new ScaleTransform(newValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		private void Procedures_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ProcedureData oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.StepsChanged -= ProcedureData_StepsChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ProcedureData newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.StepsChanged += ProcedureData_StepsChanged;
				}
			}
			InvalidateRows();
		}

		private void ProcedureData_StepsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateRows();
		}

		private void InvalidateRows()
		{
			if (_rebuildRowsOperation != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_rebuildRowsOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					RebuildRows();
				}
				finally
				{
					_rebuildRowsOperation = null;
				}
			});
		}

		private void RebuildRows()
		{
			gv.Items.Clear();
			foreach (ProcedureData procedure in Procedures)
			{
				GanttViewItem ganttViewItem = new GanttViewItem();
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem, GanttViewItem.HeaderProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ProcedureData.NameProperty.Name)
				{
					Source = procedure,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem, GanttViewItem.TooltipProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ProcedureData.DescriptionProperty.Name)
				{
					Source = procedure,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem, GanttViewItem.DurationProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ProcedureData.DurationProperty.Name)
				{
					Source = procedure,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
				foreach (OperationStepData step in procedure.Steps)
				{
					GanttViewItem ganttViewItem2 = new GanttViewItem();
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem2, GanttViewItem.HeaderProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(OperationStepData.NameProperty.Name)
					{
						Source = step,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem2, GanttViewItem.TooltipProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(OperationStepData.DescriptionProperty.Name)
					{
						Source = step,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem2, GanttViewItem.DurationProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(OperationStepData.DurationProperty.Name)
					{
						Source = step,
						Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
					});
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(ganttViewItem2, GanttViewItem.ActiveTimeRangeProperty, new MultiBinding
					{
						Bindings = 
						{
							(BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(OperationStepData.StartTimeProperty.Name)
							{
								Source = step
							},
							(BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(OperationStepData.EndTimeProperty.Name)
							{
								Source = step
							},
							(BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(CurrentTimeProperty.Name)
							{
								Source = this
							}
						},
						Converter = new GanttViewItemTimeRangeConverter()
					});
					ganttViewItem.Children.Add(ganttViewItem2);
				}
				gv.Items.Add(ganttViewItem);
			}
		}

			(d as SummaryResultsGraphView).OnZomScaleChanged((double)e.OldValue, (double)e.NewValue);

		public SummaryResultsScreen(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			if (unityContainer == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("unityContainer");
			}
			InitializeComponent();
			((ScreenContentControl)this).UnityContainer = unityContainer;
			Procedures = new ObservableCollection<ProcedureData>();
			InitializeGraphView();
			InitializeTableView();
			UpdateContent();
			SubscribeEvents();
		}

		private void InitializeGraphView()
		{
			GraphView.SetBinding(SummaryResultsGraphView.TotalTimeSpanProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(TotalTimeSpanProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			GraphView.SetBinding(SummaryResultsGraphView.ViewportRangeProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ViewportRangeProperty.Name)
			{

				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			GraphView.SetBinding(SummaryResultsGraphView.CalendarColumnWidthProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(CalendarColumnWidthProperty.Name)
			{
				Source = this,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			GraphView.SetBinding(SummaryResultsGraphView.CurrentTimeProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(CurrentTimeProperty.Name)
			{

				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			GraphView.SetBinding(SummaryResultsGraphView.TimeUnitProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(TimeUnitHelper.ResultTimeUnitProperty.Name)
			{

			GraphView.SetBinding(SummaryResultsGraphView.ZoomScaleProperty, new System.Windows.Data.Binding(ScreenContentControl.ZoomProperty.Name)

		}

		public override void InitializeScreen(IUnityContainer container, ScreenSubject screenSubject, ScreenState screenState)
		{
			((ScreenContentControl)this).InitializeScreen(container, screenSubject, screenState);
			if (screenSubject is SummaryResultsScreenSubject source)
			{
				if (screenState is SummaryResultsScreenState summaryResultsScreenState)
				{
					IsGraphMode = summaryResultsScreenState.IsGraphMode;
					((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom = ((ScreenState)summaryResultsScreenState).Zoom;
					UnitHelper.SelectedUnit = summaryResultsScreenState.TimeUnit;
				}
				((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(ScreenContentControl.HeaderProperty, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding("ScreenTitle")
				{
					Source = source,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
				InvalidateInputData();
				InvalidateResultData();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseWheel(MouseWheelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Control)
			{
				if (e.Delta > 0)
				{
					((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom = ((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom * 1.25;
				}
				else
				{
					((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom = ((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom * 0.8;
				}
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnPreviewMouseWheel(e);
		}

		private void InvalidateInputData()
		{
			if (_refreshInputDataOperation != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_refreshInputDataOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					RefreshInputData();
				}
				finally
				{
					_refreshInputDataOperation = null;
				}
			});
		}

		private void RefreshInputData()
		{
			if (DataProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<string> unitProcedureIds = DataProvider.GetUnitProcedureIds();
			RefreshUnitProcedures(unitProcedureIds);
			foreach (ProcedureData procedure in Procedures)
			{
				IEnumerable<string> operationStepIds = DataProvider.GetOperationStepIds(procedure.Name);
				RefreshOperationSteps(procedure, operationStepIds);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshUnitProcedures(IEnumerable<string> procedureIds)
		{
			if (procedureIds == null)
			{
				Procedures.Clear();
				return;
			}
			List<string> list = procedureIds.ToList();
			while (Procedures.Count > list.Count)
			{
				Procedures.RemoveAt(Procedures.Count - 1);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Procedures.Count; i++)
			{
				Procedures[i].Name = list[i];
			}
			for (int j = Procedures.Count; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				Procedures.Add(new ProcedureData
				{
					Name = list[j]
				});
			}
			foreach (ProcedureData procedure in Procedures)
			{
				procedure.Description = DataProvider.GetUnitProcedureDescription(procedure.Name);
			}
		}

		private void RefreshOperationSteps(ProcedureData procedure, IEnumerable<string> stepIds)
		{
			if (stepIds == null)
			{
				procedure.Steps.Clear();
				return;
			}
			List<string> list = stepIds.ToList();
			while (procedure.Steps.Count > list.Count)
			{
				procedure.Steps.RemoveAt(procedure.Steps.Count - 1);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < procedure.Steps.Count; i++)
			{
				procedure.Steps[i].Name = list[i];
			}
			for (int j = procedure.Steps.Count; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				procedure.Steps.Add(new OperationStepData
				{
					Name = list[j]
				});
			}
			foreach (OperationStepData step in procedure.Steps)
			{
				step.Description = DataProvider.GetOperationStepDescription(procedure.Name, step.Name);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateResultData()
		{
			if (_refreshResultDataOperation != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_refreshResultDataOperation = ((DispatcherObject)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					RefreshResultData();
				}
				finally
				{
					_refreshResultDataOperation = null;
				}
			});
		}

		private void RefreshResultData()
		{
			if (DataProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			TimeSpan? totalSimulationTime = DataProvider.GetTotalSimulationTime();
			if (!totalSimulationTime.HasValue)
			{
				ClearResultData();
				return;
			}
			TotalTimeSpan = GetTotalTimeSpanToDisplay(totalSimulationTime);
			ViewportRange = new TimeRange(TotalTimeSpan);
			CurrentTime = totalSimulationTime;
			IList<AdsUnitProcedureResultData> adsUnitProcedureResults = DataProvider.GetAdsUnitProcedureResults();
			foreach (ProcedureData procedure in Procedures)
			{
				AdsUnitProcedureResultData adsUnitProcedureResultData = adsUnitProcedureResults.FirstOrDefault((AdsUnitProcedureResultData x) => string.Equals(x.ProcedureId, procedure.Name, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase));
				if (adsUnitProcedureResultData == null)
				{
					procedure.ClearResults();
				}
				else
				{
					procedure.CopyResults(adsUnitProcedureResultData);
				}
				foreach (OperationStepData step in procedure.Steps)
				{
					step.UpdateStopCriterion(DataProvider, UnitHelper, procedure.Name);
				}
			}
		}

		private TimeSpan GetTotalTimeSpanToDisplay(TimeSpan? simulationTime)
		{
			if (!simulationTime.HasValue)
			{
				return DefaultTimeWindow;
			}
			_ = SimulatorStatusHelperForControls.Default.IsRunning;
			return simulationTime.Value;
		}

		private void ClearResultData()
		{
			TotalTimeSpan = default(TimeSpan);
			ViewportRange = default(TimeRange);
			CurrentTime = null;
			foreach (ProcedureData procedure in Procedures)
			{
				procedure.ClearResults();
			}
		}

		public override ScreenState SaveState()
		{
			SummaryResultsScreenState summaryResultsScreenState = new SummaryResultsScreenState();
			((ScreenState)summaryResultsScreenState).Zoom = ((ScreenContentControl)this).Zoom;
			summaryResultsScreenState.IsGraphMode = IsGraphMode;
			summaryResultsScreenState.TimeUnit = UnitHelper.SelectedUnit;
			return (ScreenState)(object)summaryResultsScreenState;
		}

		protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs args)
		{
			UnsubscribeEvents();
			((ScreenContentControl)this).OnClosed(args);
		}

		private void UpdateContent()
		{
			if (IsGraphMode)
			{
				contentBorder.Child = GraphView;
			}
			else
			{
				contentBorder.Child = TableView;
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeEvents()
		{
			IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((ScreenContentControl)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			((CompositePresentationEvent<UpdateDisplayEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<UpdateDisplayEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<UpdateDisplayEventArgs>)OnUpdateDisplayEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<AdsDataUpdatedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<AdsDataUpdatedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<AdsDataUpdatedEventArgs>)OnAdsDataUpdatedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectRenameEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectRenameEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<ObjectRenameEventArgs>)OnObjectRenameEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectDeleteEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectDeleteEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<ObjectDeleteEventArgs>)OnObjectDeleteEvent);
		}

		private void UnsubscribeEvents()
		{
			IEventAggregator obj = UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(((ScreenContentControl)this).UnityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>());
			((CompositePresentationEvent<UpdateDisplayEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<UpdateDisplayEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<UpdateDisplayEventArgs>)OnUpdateDisplayEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<AdsDataUpdatedEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<AdsDataUpdatedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<AdsDataUpdatedEventArgs>)OnAdsDataUpdatedEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectRenameEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectRenameEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<ObjectRenameEventArgs>)OnObjectRenameEvent);
			((CompositePresentationEvent<ObjectDeleteEventArgs>)(object)obj.GetEvent<ObjectDeleteEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<ObjectDeleteEventArgs>)OnObjectDeleteEvent);
		}

		private void OnUpdateDisplayEvent(UpdateDisplayEventArgs args)
		{
			InvalidateInputData();
			InvalidateResultData();
		}

		private void OnAdsDataUpdatedEvent(AdsDataUpdatedEventArgs args)
		{
			InvalidateResultData();
		}

		private void OnObjectRenameEvent(ObjectRenameEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsContextFlowsheetRenamed(e))
			{
				string shortObjectName = GetShortObjectName(e.NewName);
				(((ScreenContentControl)this).ScreenSubject as SummaryResultsScreenSubject).ContextFlowsheetPath = shortObjectName;
				_dataProvider = null;
			}
			InvalidateInputData();
		}

		private bool IsContextFlowsheetRenamed(ObjectRenameEventArgs args)
		{
			if (((ScreenContentControl)this).ScreenSubject is SummaryResultsScreenSubject summaryResultsScreenSubject)
			{
				return string.Equals(GetShortObjectName(summaryResultsScreenSubject.ContextFlowsheetPath), GetShortObjectName(args.OldName), StringComparison.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnObjectDeleteEvent(ObjectDeleteEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsContextFlowsheetRemoved(e))
			{
				IUnityContainer unityContainer = ((ScreenContentControl)this).UnityContainer;
				if (unityContainer == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				IShellApplication obj = UnityContainerHelper.TryResolve<IShellApplication>(unityContainer);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					IShellMainWindow activeWindow = obj.ActiveWindow;
					if (activeWindow != null)
					{
						activeWindow.CloseScreen((ScreenContentControl)(object)this);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				InvalidateInputData();
			}
		}

		private bool IsContextFlowsheetRemoved(ObjectDeleteEventArgs args)
		{
			if (((ScreenContentControl)this).ScreenSubject is SummaryResultsScreenSubject summaryResultsScreenSubject)
			{
				return string.Equals(GetShortObjectName(summaryResultsScreenSubject.ContextFlowsheetPath), GetShortObjectName(args.Name), StringComparison.InvariantCulture);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetShortObjectName(string name)
		{
			return TrimStart(TrimStart(TrimStart(TrimStart(name.Replace(".Blocks.", "."), "Top."), "AppModel."), "AppModelV8."), "Blocks.");
			static string TrimStart(string input, string test)
			{
				if (input.StartsWith(test, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return input.Substring(test.Length);
				}
				return input;
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsGraphModePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as SummaryResultsScreen).UpdateContent();
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		public void InitializeComponent()
		{
			if (!_contentLoaded)
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
				Uri resourceLocator = new Uri("/AspenTech.AspenPlus.MMForms.Blocks.BatchSep;component/unitprocedure/summaryresultsscreen.xaml", UriKind.Relative);
				System.Windows.Application.LoadComponent(this, resourceLocator);
			}
		}

		[DebuggerNonUserCode]
		[GeneratedCode("PresentationBuildTasks", "4.0.0.0")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		void IComponentConnector.Connect(int connectionId, object target)
		{
			if (connectionId == 1)
			{
				contentBorder = (Border)target;
			}
			else
			{
				_contentLoaded = true;
			}
		}
	}

		public TimeUnitHelper(IUnityContainer unityContainer)
		{
			if (unityContainer == null)

				throw new ArgumentNullException("unityContainer");

			ResetSelectedUnit();
			SubscribeEvent();
		}

		protected virtual void OnResultTimeUnitChanged()
		{
			this.ResultTimeUnitChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private void SubscribeEvent()
		{
			((CompositePresentationEvent<AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEvent>()).Subscribe((Action<AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEventArgs>)OnAplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEvent);
		}

		public void UnsubscribeEvent()
		{
			((CompositePresentationEvent<AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEventArgs>)(object)UnityContainerExtensions.Resolve<IEventAggregator>(_unityContainer, Array.Empty<ResolverOverride>()).GetEvent<AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEvent>()).Unsubscribe((Action<AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEventArgs>)OnAplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEvent);
		}

		private void OnAplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEvent(AplusGlobalUnitSetChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			ResetSelectedUnit();
		}

		private void RefreshUnitsList()
		{
			if (UnitsProvider != null)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				IEnumerable<string> unitsList = UnitsProvider.GetUnitsList((object)24);
				if (unitsList != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(unitsList);
				}
				UnitsList = list;
			}
		}

		private void ResetSelectedUnit()
		{
			if (UnitsProvider != null)
			{
				if (UnitsList == null)
				{
					RefreshUnitsList();
				}
				SelectedUnit = UnitsProvider.GetDefaultDisplayUnits((object)24);
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateResultTimeUnit()
		{
			if (_refreshResultOperation != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_refreshResultOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					RefreshResultTimeUnit();
				}
				finally
				{
					_refreshResultOperation = null;
				}
			});
		}

		private void RefreshResultTimeUnit()
		{
			if (UnitsProvider != null)
			{
				double? num = UnitsProvider.ConvertFromSI((object)24, 1.0, SelectedUnit);
				if (num.HasValue)
				{
					ResultTimeUnit = new TimeUnitInfo(num.Value, SelectedUnit);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedUnitPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as TimeUnitHelper).InvalidateResultTimeUnit();
		}

		private static void OnResultTimeUnitPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as TimeUnitHelper).OnResultTimeUnitChanged();
		}
	}

			public static SrtvRow CreateProcedureRow(DataTable parentTable, ProcedureData procedure)
			{
				if (parentTable == null)

					throw new ArgumentNullException("parentTable");
				}

				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("procedure");
				}
				return new SrtvRow(parentTable)
				{
					RowType = SrtvRowType.UnitProcedure,
					Procedure = procedure
				};
			}

			public static SrtvRow CreateOperationStepRow(DataTable parentTable, ProcedureData procedure, OperationStepData operationStep)

				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("procedure");
				}
				if (operationStep == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("operationStep");
				}
				return new SrtvRow(parentTable)
				{
					RowType = SrtvRowType.OperationStep,
					Procedure = procedure,
					OperationStep = operationStep
				};
			}
		}

		private void InitializeGridControl()

		public void InitializeProcedures(ObservableCollection<ProcedureData> procedures)
		{
			if (procedures == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("procedures");
			}
			if (Procedures != null)
			{
				Procedures.CollectionChanged -= Procedures_CollectionChanged;
			}
			Procedures = procedures;
			Procedures.CollectionChanged += Procedures_CollectionChanged;
		}

		private void Procedures_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ProcedureData oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.StepsChanged -= ProcedureData_StepsChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ProcedureData newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.StepsChanged += ProcedureData_StepsChanged;
				}
			}
			InvalidateRows();
		}

		private void ProcedureData_StepsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateRows();
		}

		private void InvalidateRows()
		{
			if (_updateRowsOperation != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_updateRowsOperation = base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					RebuildRows();
				}
				finally
				{
					_updateRowsOperation = null;
				}
			});
		}

		private void RebuildRows()
		{
			DataTable dataSource = theGridControl.DataSource;
			if (dataSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DataRow> list = new List<DataRow>();
			foreach (ProcedureData procedure in Procedures)
			{
				SrtvRow srtvRow = SrtvRow.CreateProcedureRow(dataSource, procedure);
				((DataRow)srtvRow).GroupingRowsCount = procedure.Steps.Count;
				list.Add((DataRow)(object)srtvRow);
				foreach (OperationStepData step in procedure.Steps)
				{
					SrtvRow item = SrtvRow.CreateOperationStepRow(dataSource, procedure, step);
					list.Add((DataRow)(object)item);
				}
			}
			dataSource.UpdateRows((IEnumerable<DataRow>)list);
		}

		private void theGridControl_CellValueQueried(object sender, CellValueQueriedEventArgs e)
		{
			SrtvRow srtvRow = e.Row as SrtvRow;
			SrtvColumn srtvColumn = e.Column as SrtvColumn;
			if (srtvRow == null || srtvColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (srtvRow.RowType == SrtvRowType.UnitProcedure && srtvRow.Procedure != null)
			{
				switch (srtvColumn.ColumnType)
				{
				case SrtvColumnType.UnitProcedure:
					e.Data = Create<DataCellText>((object)srtvRow.Procedure, ProcedureData.NameProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.Duration:
					e.Data = (IDataCell)(object)CreateTimeSpanCell(srtvRow.Procedure, ProcedureData.DurationProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.StartTime:
					e.Data = (IDataCell)(object)CreateTimeSpanCell(srtvRow.Procedure, ProcedureData.StartTimeProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.EndTime:
					e.Data = (IDataCell)(object)CreateTimeSpanCell(srtvRow.Procedure, ProcedureData.EndTimeProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.OperationStep:
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (srtvRow.RowType == SrtvRowType.OperationStep && srtvRow.OperationStep != null)
			{
				OperationStepData operationStep = srtvRow.OperationStep;
				switch (srtvColumn.ColumnType)
				{
				case SrtvColumnType.OperationStep:
					e.Data = Create<DataCellText>((object)operationStep, OperationStepData.NameProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.Duration:
					e.Data = (IDataCell)(object)CreateTimeSpanCell(operationStep, OperationStepData.DurationProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.StartTime:
					e.Data = (IDataCell)(object)CreateTimeSpanCell(operationStep, OperationStepData.StartTimeProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.EndTime:
					e.Data = (IDataCell)(object)CreateTimeSpanCell(operationStep, OperationStepData.EndTimeProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.StopCriterionVariable:
					e.Data = Create<DataCellText>((object)operationStep.StopCriterion, StopCriterionData.DescriptionProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.StopCriterionTriggerValue:
					e.Data = Create<DataCellDouble>((object)operationStep.StopCriterion, StopCriterionData.TriggerValueProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.StopCriterionUnit:
					e.Data = Create<DataCellText>((object)operationStep.StopCriterion, StopCriterionData.TriggerValueUnitProperty.Name);
					break;
				case SrtvColumnType.StopCriterionApproachFrom:
					e.Data = Create<DataCellText>((object)operationStep.StopCriterion, StopCriterionData.ApproachFromProperty.Name);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private IDataCell Create<T>(object bindingSource, string bindingPath) where T : IDataCell, new()
		{
			T val = new T();
			((IDataCell)val/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).SetBinding(DataCell<string>.ValueProperty.Name, (BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(bindingPath)
			{
				Source = bindingSource,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			return (IDataCell)(object)val;
		}

		private DataCellDouble CreateTimeSpanCell(object bindingSource, string timeSpanPropertyName)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0065: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0066: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataCellDouble val = new DataCellDouble();
			((DataCell<double?>)val).SetBinding(DataCell<double?>.ValueProperty.Name, (BindingBase)new MultiBinding
			{
				Bindings = 
				{
					(BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(timeSpanPropertyName)
					{
						Source = bindingSource
					},
					(BindingBase)new System.Windows.Data.Binding(TimeUnitProperty.Name)
					{
						Source = this
					}
				},

				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			return val;
		}

		private void theGridControl_DefaultContextMenuOpening(object sender, DefaultContextMenuEventArgs e)
		{
			e.DefaultContextMenu.Items.Insert(0, new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem
			{
				Icon = new Image
				{
					Source = ImageSourceHelper.Copy16
				},
				Command = ApplicationCommands.Copy,
				CommandTarget = (IInputElement)theGridControl
			});
			bool flag = e.IsOpenFromBlankArea || e.IsOpenFromHeaderPrefixArea || e.IsOpenFromRowHeader;
			if (!flag && e.IsOpenFromGridCell && e.SourceCell.Column != null && e.SourceCell.Column.DisplayIndex == 0)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				e.DefaultContextMenu.Items.Add(new Separator());
				e.DefaultContextMenu.Items.Add(new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem
				{
					Command = GridControl.ExpandAllCommand,
					CommandTarget = (IInputElement)theGridControl
				});
				e.DefaultContextMenu.Items.Add(new System.Windows.Controls.MenuItem
				{
					Command = GridControl.CollapseAllCommand,
					CommandTarget = (IInputElement)theGridControl
				});
			}
		}

	public class TimeSpanToTextConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length == 2)
			{
				TimeSpan? span = values[0] as TimeSpan?;
				if (values[1] is TimeUnitInfo)
				{
					return span.ToDisplayText((TimeUnitInfo)values[1]);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

	public class GanttViewItemMarginConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length == 4)
			{
				TimeRange? timeRange = values[0] as TimeRange?;
				if (timeRange.HasValue && values[1] is TimeSpan && values[2] is double && values[3] is double)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan = (TimeSpan)values[1];
					double num = (double)values[2];
					double num2 = (double)values[3];
					TimeRange? timeRange2 = timeRange.Value.IntersectWith(new TimeRange(timeSpan));
					if (timeRange2.HasValue)
					{
						return new Thickness(Math.Min(timeRange2.Value.StartTime.DividedBy(timeSpan) * num, num - num2), 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
					}
				}
			}
			return default(Thickness);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class GanttViewItemWidthConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values != null && values.Length == 3)
			{
				TimeRange? timeRange = values[0] as TimeRange?;
				if (timeRange.HasValue && values[1] is TimeSpan && values[2] is double)
				{
					TimeSpan timeSpan = (TimeSpan)values[1];
					double num = (double)values[2];
					TimeRange? timeRange2 = timeRange.Value.IntersectWith(new TimeRange(timeSpan));
					if (timeRange2.HasValue)
					{
						double num2 = timeRange2.Value.StartTime.DividedBy(timeSpan) * num;
						double num3 = timeRange2.Value.Duration.DividedBy(timeSpan) * num;
						if (num2 + num3 > num)
						{
							return num - num2;
						}
						return timeRange2.Value.Duration.DividedBy(timeSpan) * num;
					}
				}
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public class GanttView : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, IComponentConnector
	{
		private class CalendarCalulationHelper
		{
			private const double MinLabelWidth = 60.0;

			private readonly GanttView _gv;

			private DispatcherOperation _updateCalendarUnitLengthOperation;

			public CalendarCalulationHelper(GanttView gv)
			{
				_gv = gv;
			}

			public void InvalidateCalendarUnitLength()
			{
				if (_updateCalendarUnitLengthOperation != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				_updateCalendarUnitLengthOperation = _gv.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					try
					{
						UpdateCalendarUnitLength();
					}
					finally
					{
						_updateCalendarUnitLengthOperation = null;
					}
				});
			}

			private void UpdateCalendarUnitLength()
			{
				if (_gv.AutoUpdateCalendar)
				{
					double actualWidth = _gv.workspaceGrid.ActualWidth;
					double num = CalculateUnitTime(_gv.TotalTimeSpan.GetNumberAt(_gv.TimeUnit), actualWidth, 60.0);
					_gv.CalendarUnitLength = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(num / _gv.TimeUnit.FactorOnSI);
				}
			}

			private static double CalculateUnitTime(double totalTime, double totalWidth, double minLabelWidth)
			{
				if (totalTime <= 0.0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				if (totalWidth < minLabelWidth * 2.0)
				{
					return totalTime;
				}
				double minStep = Math.Pow(10.0, (int)Math.Log10(totalTime) - 1);
				return GetSuggestedElementLength(totalTime, minStep, totalWidth, minLabelWidth);
			}

			private static double GetSuggestedElementLength(double totalTime, double minStep, double totalWidth, double minLabelWidth)
			{
				double num = totalTime * (minLabelWidth / totalWidth);
				_ = totalWidth / minLabelWidth;
				double num2 = totalTime / 2.0;
				double num3 = minStep / 2.0;
				double result = minStep;
				for (double num4 = minStep; num4 <= num2; num4 += num3)
				{
					if (num4 > num2)
					{
						return result;
					}
					if (num4 >= num && totalTime % num4 >= num)
					{
						return num4;
					}
					result = num4;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private CalendarCalulationHelper CalendarHelper => _calendarHelper ?? (_calendarHelper = new CalendarCalulationHelper(this));

		private void ExpandAllCommand_Executed(object parameter)
		{
			foreach (GanttViewItem item in Items)
			{
				item.IsChildrenCollapsed = false;
			}
		}

		private bool ExpandAllCommand_CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return Items.Any((GanttViewItem x) => x.IsChildrenCollapsed);
		}

		private void CollapseAllCommand_Executed(object parameter)
		{
			foreach (GanttViewItem item in Items)
			{
				item.IsChildrenCollapsed = true;
			}
		}

		private bool CollapseAllCommand_CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return Items.Any((GanttViewItem x) => !x.IsChildrenCollapsed);
		}

			Items.CollectionChanged += Items_CollectionChanged;

			verticalScrollBar.Scroll += VerticalScrollBar_Scroll;
		}
